title: Business Coordinator - Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
Buyers Agents Adelaide | Part-time | Remote

Executive support, inbox management and project coordination



At Buyers Agents Adelaide, we believe in the power of property to enable a life of freedom and abundance. We combine heartfelt care with high performance, and that care extends to our team.



We’re looking for an experienced, proactive Business Coordinator who loves creating order, anticipating next steps and helping ideas become reality.



Working directly with our award-winning Director, you’ll provide trusted support that creates space for her to focus on clients, relationships and growing the business.



A place to contribute and grow.



We want you to feel supported, valued and encouraged to bring your strengths forward. Through clear priorities, regular constructive feedback and opportunities to learn, we’ll support you to grow in confidence, make a meaningful contribution and become the best version of yourself.



If you share our values of Effervescence, Grow, Service, Leadership, High Performance and Compassion, we’d love to hear from you.



What you’ll do



-Manage the Director’s inbox, prioritise messages, draft responses and follow up outstanding items.

-Coordinate appointments, meetings and calendar commitments.

-Follow up enquiries and prospective clients within an agreed process.

-Turn agreed projects into clear actions and deadlines, keeping work moving through to completion.

-Coordinate with team members and external partners, following up information, documents and commitments.

-Prepare correspondence, documents and research with accuracy and attention to detail.

-Support the coordination of community events and initiatives.

-Maintain accurate CRM records and shared task trackers.

-Help improve and document recurring administrative processes.

-Provide personal administrative support, including bookings and purchases.





What you’ll bring

-Ideally 3 or more years experience in executive assistance, business coordination or a similar role.

-Initiative and reliable follow-through: you can take an agreed outcome, identify the next steps and progress the work.

-Excellent written and verbal English.

-Strong organisation, attention to detail and professional discretion.

-Confidence managing competing priorities and raising issues early.

-Practical experience using AI tools for drafting, research and organisation, while checking accuracy and handling confidential information appropriately.

-Confidence using Google Workspace, particularly Gmail, Drive, Docs and Sheets, and Microsoft Office.

-A positive attitude, openness to feedback and a desire to grow.

-Real estate experience and basic Canva skills are desirable, but not essential.

-You’ll be comfortable working independently within clear boundaries and asking focused questions when guidance or approval is needed.



Hours and opportunity

Initially 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, within Adelaide, South Australia, with the opportunity to progress to full-time based on performance and business needs. 



Remuneration

Starting at US$4.80 / hour with remuneration reviewed based on performance during the initial three month period. 



How to apply



1) Send your resume.

2) Include a tailored cover letter outlining your suitability for this role.

3) Include “Elevate Your Life” in the subject line. 



We look forward to learning about you and the strengths you could bring to Buyers Agents Adelaide.

title: Senior Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online & Xero
description:
Hi, I’m Jon. I am the owner of an e-commerce business for over 10 years, and sold more than $20 million on Amazon. I’m starting a bookkeeping service for e-commerce owners and other small businesses, and I’m looking for an experienced bookkeeper to be my first hire.



I’ll bring in clients and manage the client relationships. You’ll own the bookkeeping for your assigned clients, from reviewing their books at onboarding through cleanup, and preparing their monthly profit and loss statement (P&L) and balance sheet. We’ll work directly together, including on calls to discuss questions and review the work.



What you’ll do

• Assess new clients’ books. Review the file, identify the last reconciled month, and flag missing records or balances that need investigation. Estimate initial cleanup hours separately from recurring monthly hours so I can quote the work accurately.

• Handle setup and cleanup. Set up books from scratch in QuickBooks Online or Xero, including the chart of accounts, opening balances, and bank feeds. For existing clients, complete approved catch-up work and document corrections.

• Own the monthly close. Categorize transactions, match payments to invoices, record transfers and processing fees, and reconcile bank, credit card, and other relevant accounts to supporting statements.

• Prepare and review financial statements. Deliver the monthly P&L and balance sheet with supporting reconciliations and a short note explaining unusual changes or items that need my attention.

• Keep each client’s work on schedule. Track deadlines and time spent. When you need information from a client, send me a concise list of questions with the dates, amounts, and details I need to get you an answer.



What I’m looking for

• Strong spoken and written English is required. You must be comfortable joining me on voice or video calls, explaining a bookkeeping issue clearly in plain English, and answering follow-up questions as we work through it together.

• Experience independently managing monthly closes for several small-business clients at the same time.

• Hands-on proficiency in both QuickBooks Online and Xero, including account setup, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

• Experience taking over an existing set of books, assessing the cleanup required, and completing the work.

• Good judgment about what you can resolve independently and when to bring a question to me.



Experience with U.S. small businesses or e-commerce clients is a plus. I also welcome applicants who have managed books for service businesses and other industries.



Pay and growth

This is an hourly role to start, with a small initial workload as the business launches and I build our client roster. There’s an opportunity to take on more clients and grow into a team lead / managerial role as we expand. Also open to performance bonuses as the role develops. 



How to apply

Please send your résumé, preferred hourly rate and currency, and weekly availability. Include brief answers to these four questions using examples from your own work.

1. How many clients’ books have you been responsible for closing in the same month? Which parts did you complete yourself, and who reviewed the finished work?

2. When did you last complete a monthly close in QuickBooks Online and in Xero? What kinds of businesses were they?

3. Tell me about a cleanup you handled. What did you find when you first reviewed the file, and how did you determine the books were ready for regular monthly bookkeeping?

4. For the average client, how many hours do/did you spend each month getting from statements to finished reports



I’ll invite shortlisted applicants to a brief call in English. We’ll discuss one bookkeeping issue you’ve handled, how you resolved it, and a few follow-up questions, just as we would when reviewing a client’s books together.

title: Senior Backend Developer: Strong Fundamentals + Claude Code
description:
If Claude Code runs your terminal, repos and servers, and you still read every diff before it ships, let's talk.



Already employed and ready for an upgrade? You are exactly who we want to hear from. This role is meant to be a clear step up, not a sideways move.



Remote · 4pm –12 am PH time (8am – 4pm UK; an hour earlier during UK summer time)



THE ROLE

You'll own the backend of a platform that is already moving: payment partners are signed and the frontend is in good hands. Your focus is sign-ups and authentication, payments, security and fraud, data, and logging. It's a high-trust role with real ownership, and experienced devs on the team are on hand when you need them.



YOU BRING

You're a developer first. AI makes you faster; it isn't what makes you good.

- Senior backend experience running production systems, ideally with auth and payment integrations

- Strong command of a modern backend language, relational databases and cloud infrastructure

- A security-first mindset: you know where systems that handle money and personal data tend to break

- Daily Claude Code use: you set up agents, rules and tests, and you catch it when it's wrong



HOW WE WORK

- AI does much of the typing; you do the thinking

- Meetings only when they are useful

- A hard stop at the end of the day



WE OFFER

- Pay designed to be an upgrade

- Flexible paid leave

- Claude Code and the tools you need, on us



TO APPLY

Send your CV with the subject line "Backend + Claude Code", your expected monthly salary (PHP, full-time), and a few lines, in your own words, about a time AI gave you code that looked right but wasn't. Shortlisted candidates get one interview, including a short demo of how you work.

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer 



Full-time | Remote | Melbourne business hours | AUD $2,500 per month



Who We Are



OxyScale is an Australian company that builds custom analytics platforms for medium to large businesses with complex operations across Australia.



Our clients typically operate across multiple disconnected systems, including accounting, payroll, rostering, CRM, practice management, job management and spreadsheets. Each system holds a different part of the picture.



We bring all of that information together into one central source of truth, creating a platform tailored to how each business operates and one their teams can rely on every day.



Every platform we build is different. We don't use off-the-shelf reports or one-size-fits-all dashboards.



For example, a recruitment agency might need visibility over placements, margins and consultant performance. An allied health group might need to track clinician hours, utilisation and clinic profitability. A disability services provider, surveying firm, migration law practice or wealth management group will have entirely different requirements.



Each platform is designed around how that particular business operates, performs and makes money.



We currently have around a dozen clients, most with live platforms, and we're growing quickly.



What makes this role different is how we build.



Our fulfilment process is powered by AI coding agents through a structured process we've spent the past year developing.



That process includes detailed step-by-step procedures, automated quality checks at every stage and independent AI reviewers that rigorously test the numbers before anything reaches a client.



Your role isn't to spend all day manually writing SQL or building dashboards in traditional BI tools.



Instead, you'll direct the AI agents, review their work, test their outputs and take responsibility for the finished product.



The Role



You'll be responsible for managing client builds from start to finish using our established fulfilment process, as well as maintaining and improving platforms once they're live.



You'll report directly to the two founders and work closely with us every day.



What a typical client build looks like



1.⁠ ⁠Scoping



Our AI agents review the client's call transcripts, proposal and available data to determine what the dashboard needs to answer and how it should be structured.



You'll guide this process, identify anything the agents may have missed and ensure every important question the client wants answered is reflected in the platform.



2.⁠ ⁠Data Warehouse



Each client receives a private data warehouse within our Microsoft Azure environment.



Provisioning is scripted and largely automated. You'll run and verify the setup, ensuring everything is configured correctly and that client credentials, permissions and access are handled securely.



3.⁠ ⁠Data Connections



We connect the client's existing systems using APIs, scheduled exports,
 feeds and, where necessary, browser-based automations.



These connections bring in the client's historical data and keep the platform updated with ongoing changes.



We already have a library of connectors, and our AI agents build new ones as required.



You'll oversee this process, test connections against the live source systems and troubleshoot anything that isn't working correctly.



4.⁠ ⁠Metrics and Data Accuracy



Every metric displayed on a client's platform is defined in one central location, with a clear written definition of how it should be calculated.



The AI agents develop these definitions, independent reviewers challenge them, and you'll ensure the final numbers are accurate, consistent and explainable.



5.⁠ ⁠Dashboard Development



Our dashboards are assembled using our existing chart library and design standards.



You'll direct the agents through the development process, review each tab from the client's perspective and ensure the final platform is clear and aligns with the agreed scope.



6.⁠ ⁠Quality Assurance



Before anything goes live, it must pass automated quality checks, a final audit and a reconciliation of our figures against the client's own records.



You'll run these checks, review the evidence and ensure any outstanding issues are resolved before release.



Once a client is live



Your responsibilities will extend into two additional areas.



Platform Maintenance and Improvements



The founders will continue managing all client-facing communication.



You'll work behind the scenes to implement client requests, make improvements, develop new tabs, investigate discrepancies and resolve technical issues.



For example, if a client questions a figure or a nightly data refresh stops working because a source system has changed, you'll investigate the underlying cause, make the necessary correction, verify the result and release the update.



Internal Automation and Process Improvements



We're continually looking for ways to make our fulfilment process and internal operations more efficient.



As you become familiar with how we work, we'll encourage you to identify opportunities for improvement and use your AI and automation skills to implement them.



That could involve building internal tools, monitoring systems, scripts or automations that save the team time and improve reliability.



Your ideas and input are not only welcome, they're expected.



Your primary responsibility will always be building and maintaining high-quality client platforms. Everything else supports that goal.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for an AI-native builder.



Someone who has, hands-on experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar AI coding agents to build real, working products.



That might include applications, dashboards, automations or internal business systems you've built for yourself, an employer or a client.



We're particularly interested in people who have built things that are actually being used and can confidently walk us through how they work.



Must Have



Strong written and spoken English. You'll communicate with the founders daily through chat and voice, follow detailed procedures, provide clear progress updates and contribute your own ideas. Good communication is essential.



Demonstrable experience building with AI coding agents. We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to prompt a chatbot. You need experience directing agents through multi-step builds, reviewing their work, testing the results and correcting issues.



At least one substantial AI-built project that you can demonstrate.



Comfort with core development tools, including the terminal, Git and reading SQL, Python or TypeScript well enough to understand and review changes. Senior engineering experience is not required.



Experience handling sensitive information and a responsible approach to data security. Our clients trust us with financial, payroll, employee and customer information.



Excellent attention to detail, along with the willingness to question results and speak up when something doesn't look right.



Highly Regarded



Experience building dashboards, analytics platforms or reporting tools.



Hands-on data experience, including working with messy datasets, investigating incorrect figures, data modelling, dbt, PostgreSQL or cloud data warehouses.



Experience with automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs and scheduled workflows.



Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform.



Previous experience working in a startup or small, fast-moving team.



What You Don't Need



You don't need a computer science degree or an extensive engineering career.



What you've actually built, how you approach problems and your ability to work effectively with AI matter far more to us than your qualifications or years of experience.



If Your Background Is in BI or Data Analytics



Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, SQL or data modelling is certainly valuable, and we'd love to hear about it.



However, traditional BI development isn't the primary focus of this role.



Our AI agents handle much of the technical implementation.



What we're looking for is someone who knows how to direct those agents, critically review their work, verify the results and take ownership of the finished product.



Above all, we want to see what you've built using AI.



The Type of Person Who Will Thrive Here



You'll enjoy this role if you're proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a startup environment where things move quickly and processes continue to evolve.



You should be someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, is eager to learn and genuinely wants to grow alongside the business.



As OxyScale grows, there's an opportunity for this position to develop into a leadership role overseeing our fulfilment operations.



The Practical Details



Employment: Full-time, remote position



Working hours: At least six hours of overlap with Melbourne business hours (9:00 am to 5:00 pm) each working day.



Salary: AUD $2,500 per month.



Software: Your own Claude subscription is paid for by OxyScale, along with any other software and accounts required for your role.



Reporting: You'll work directly with the founders, with daily communication through chat and voice. Much of your work will be completed independently, supported by clear written progress updates.



Confidentiality and security: A confidentiality agreement and background check are required due to the sensitive nature of our clients' data.



Probation: Three months.



Exclusivity: This must be your only job. We're looking for someone who can commit to the role full time.



Start date: As soon as practical. [Start date]



How to Apply



We're far more interested in seeing what you've built than reading a long list of qualifications.



Please send us the following:



1.⁠ ⁠A video walkthrough of your favourite project built using AI.



This is the most important part of your application.



Record a video using Loom or another screen recording tool, with your voice explaining:



What you built and what it does.



How you approached the build.



Which AI coding agents you used and what they handled.



What you personally contributed, corrected or improved.



What the finished product has made possible for you, your employer or your client.



Applications, dashboards, automations and internal tools are all welcome.



2.⁠ ⁠Your CV.



3.⁠ ⁠Optional: Links to your portfolio or other projects you've built.



Send your application to: 
 & 
 with the subject “JOB APPLICATION" 



Shortlisted applicants will meet directly with the founders, demonstrate their work live and complete a short practical exercise.

description:
We’re looking for a creative and analytical person to help us plan, develop, and improve ads for our e-commerce brand.



You will research our customers, develop compelling advertising ideas, prepare clear creative briefs, and work closely with our copywriters, video editors, and media buyer. Your goal is to help the team consistently produce ads that capture attention, communicate our product’s value, and encourage purchases.



Your responsibilities:



1. Customer and product research

-Understand our products, benefits, target audience, and brand voice.

-Study customer reviews, comments, questions, and feedback.

-Identify customers’ needs, frustrations, buying motivations, and objections.

-Research competitor ads and relevant trends to find opportunities for original concepts.



2. Creative planning and concept development

-Develop ad ideas for different customer needs and levels of product awareness.

-Propose hooks, storytelling approaches, product demonstrations, and image ad concepts.

-Explain the audience, purpose, and reasoning behind each concept.

-Maintain an organized list of ideas and prioritize concepts for production.



3. Creative briefs and team direction

-Prepare briefs covering the hook, key message, script direction, visuals, references, and call to action.

-Give editors clear instructions about footage, pacing, captions, music, and product presentation.

-Work with copywriters to strengthen scripts and keep the message focused.

-Answer production questions and help the team resolve unclear instructions.



4. Performance analysis and testing

-Work with the media buyer to understand which ads perform well.

-Look for patterns in successful hooks, messages, formats, and visuals.

-Recommend what to test next and explain the reason for each change.

-Develop fresh versions of successful concepts.

-Document results so the team can apply what it learns to future ads.



What we’re looking for:



-Experience with e-commerce advertising or creative strategy.

-Strong customer research, copywriting, and storytelling skills.

-Ability to turn research into practical ad ideas and clear briefs.

-Understanding of paid social advertising and basic performance metrics.

title: Product Data & Documentation Coordinator (Food & Beverage)
description:
Job Title: Product Data & Documentation Coordinator (Food & Beverage)

Type of Work: Part Time

Hours per Week: 20

Salary: USD 8/hour (approx. USD 690/month)



About Us



We are a food and beverage product development company. We build our own brands and develop products for other businesses, handling formulation, supply chain, regulatory and commercial strategy. Our products are sold in major Australian supermarkets, convenience stores, pharmacies and specialty retailers.



We’re a small team running many products at once, so the records behind each product need to be right.



About the Role



We’re hiring a Product Data & Documentation Coordinator to own the accuracy of every unit economics model and product formulation sheet in the business. Anyone who opens one of these records should be able to trust it.



The records live in Notion and Google Drive. They change all the time: ingredient prices move, suppliers send new quotes, formulas change after trials, and pack sizes or nutrition panels get updated. An out-of-date sheet costs real money. A price might be quoted off the wrong cost, a manufacturer might be briefed on an old formula, or a label might stop matching the product. Your job is to close that gap.



This is not a formulation or pricing role. Our Head of Product Development makes the technical calls and our Founder makes the pricing and commercial decisions. Your job is to make sure the record of those decisions is complete, current and correct.



Work Setup



Schedule: Part-time, 20 hours per week

Location: Remote

Timezone: Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST). You need to overlap with our business hours.

Reports to: Founder, working daily with the Head of Product Development

Rate: USD 8 per hour



Key Responsibilities



Unit Economics



Keep the unit economics model current for every product, including ingredient, packaging, manufacturing, freight and trade cost inputs

Update a model as soon as a supplier quote, price list or formulation change comes in, and record where each number came from

Keep every model in our house format, including the CM1, CM2 and CM3 contribution margin layers

Check formulas and links so totals add up and no calculation has been overwritten with a typed-in number

Tell the Founder the same day about any change that moves a product’s margin past an agreed threshold



Formulation Sheets



Maintain one current, version-controlled formulation sheet per product, with old versions clearly archived

Enter changes from the product development team after each bench trial, sample round or production run

Reconcile each formulation sheet with its unit economics model so the costed recipe is always the real recipe

Check that ingredient specifications, supplier details and inclusion rates match the latest supplier documents

Raise any mismatch between the formulation, nutrition panel and label with the Head of Product Development



Notion & Google Drive



Own the structure of the product workspace in Notion and the matching folders in Google Drive

Set and enforce naming, versioning and filing rules so every document has one obvious home

Remove duplicates, fix broken links and archive dead files

Keep product status, owners and key dates current in Notion



Change Control & Reporting



Keep a simple change log: what changed, when, who approved it and which documents were updated

Hold a short weekly check-in with the Head of Product Development to catch changes nobody recorded

Audit every live product’s documents on a rolling schedule and report what you found and fixed

Send the Founder a one-page summary each week covering changes, open questions and anything overdue



What Success Looks Like



By day 14: You have audited the formulation sheet and unit economics model for every live product, and agreed a list of gaps and errors with the Founder

By day 30: All gaps are closed. Each product has one current formulation sheet and one current model, they reconcile, and naming and filing rules are in place

By day 45: The change log and weekly check-in are routine, every change shows up in the documents within 1 business day, and a spot check of any product finds no errors



Requirements



2+ years in an administration, data, costing or operations coordination role

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills. You can read someone else’s model, trace a formula and spot what’s broken

Comfortable with basic costing: cost of goods, margins and percentages

Exceptional attention to detail, shown in your previous work

Confident chasing busy people for information, politely and persistently

Organised and self-directed. You keep a routine running without being reminded



Nice to Have



Experience in food, beverage, supplements or another FMCG category

Familiarity with formulation sheets, bills of materials or product specifications

Hands-on experience building or maintaining a Notion workspace

Exposure to document control or quality systems

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs more.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

Support here runs around the clock, in three 8-hour shifts (Philippine time):

• Afternoon and evening: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM

• Graveyard: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM

• Morning: 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM

In the application form, tell us every shift you can work. We agree on yours together, and then it stays fixed.

Whatever your shift, the job is the same:

• You own the queue while you are on. Every customer gets an answer, every order problem gets followed.

• On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of the queue.

• Before you log off, you brief the next agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. One fixed day off, agreed together. It cannot be Saturday, Sunday or Monday.

• One fixed shift, agreed together (see the three shifts above): 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $1,000 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🕐 A fixed shift, chosen with you. No split shift, no schedule that changes every week.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.

In return: your salary grows over time, you earn performance bonuses, and you take on more responsibility as the brand grows.



➤ How to apply

Apply through this form: 

If the link does not show, send us a message and we will send it to you.

Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



➤ Our hiring process

1. Application form

2. Quick video interview with the founder

3. You start. The first month is a paid trial, then it's a long-term role

title: E-Commerce Specialist (Shopify, SEO & Social Media Growth)
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a data-driven, creative, and proactive E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist who wears multiple hats comfortably. In this role, you will be the engine behind our online storefront—ensuring our Shopify website runs smoothly, optimizing our organic search rankings (SEO), and executing engaging social media strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and sales.



If you have a strong mix of technical e-commerce skills, organic growth expertise, and a sharp eye for content, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

1. Shopify Website Management

Maintain, update, and optimize our Shopify store to ensure a seamless user experience (UX) and high conversion rates.

Upload new products, manage variants, organize collections, and update pricing/inventory as needed.

Monitor site performance, fix broken links, troubleshoot checkout issues, and implement apps or features to improve site functionality.

Collaborate on landing page creation and layout design for promotional campaigns and product launches.



2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Execute on-page and technical SEO strategies to improve organic search visibility and rankings on Google.

Conduct keyword research to identify high-intent search terms for our products and blog content.

Optimize meta titles, descriptions, image alt text, and product descriptions for search engines.

Monitor traffic, rankings, and conversions using Google Analytics and Google Search Console, providing regular performance reports.



3. Social Media Management & Content

Plan, create, and schedule engaging organic content across our core social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest).

Write compelling captions and collaborate on visual assets (graphics, short-form reels/videos) that align with our brand identity.

Engage with our community, respond to comments and messages, and foster brand loyalty.

Track social media metrics and engagement trends to continuously refine our content strategy.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Proven experience (2+ years) managing Shopify stores, running SEO campaigns, and managing social media channels for e-commerce brands.

Shopify Proficiency: Deep familiarity with the Shopify admin dashboard, theme settings, product management, and basic troubleshooting.

SEO Expertise: Solid understanding of technical and on-page SEO best practices, keyword research tools, and Google Search Console/Analytics.

Social Media Savvy: Experience creating content calendars, utilizing scheduling tools, and understanding what drives engagement on platforms like Instagram and TikTok.

Strong Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Self-Starter: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently in a remote work environment.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit your proposal with the following:

A brief introduction about yourself and your background in e-commerce.

Links to Shopify stores you have managed or optimized.

Examples of successful SEO or social media campaigns you’ve run (with results, if possible).

Please include the phrase "E-Commerce Pro" at the very top of your application so we know you read the full description.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.



This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.



For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.



Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.



Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.



Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.



Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.



Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.



Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.



Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.



What we look for



Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.



Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.



Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.



Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.



Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.



Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.



Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 
/?job=virasst_jazz

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply here:

title: Online Learning Coach + English & Humanities Tutor (UK Curriculum) – Part-Time, Daytime
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read to the end. The application instructions are at the bottom, and applications that skip

them will not be read.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a family in Singapore looking for a patient, creative Learning Coach for a 17-year-old student. He

studies a UK homeschool curriculum (Wolsey Hall Oxford, Lower Secondary Year 8–9) on the Canvas

platform.



Wolsey Hall's own tutors teach the courses and mark his work. Your job is different: help him show up, get

started, stay with it, and submit his OWN work, every weekday. You are his daily coach and the person who

keeps all six courses moving.



Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone, so this is a normal daytime schedule.



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Friday, 1.5 hours a day (7.5 hours/week), at fixed times:

10:00–11:10 AM: daily check-in + main subject block

12:20–12:40 PM: end-of-day wrap-up

• Live video sessions on a Zoom/Google Meet link we provide.



YOUR SUBJECTS

• English (Year 9)

• Geography (Year 8)

• Skills for Life (Year 9)

• Digital Literacy (Year 9)

A separate tutor handles Maths and Science. You coordinate with them and keep the overall picture.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Start each day with a 10-minute check-in: what is due on Canvas and 2–3 targets for the day.

• Run a focused 1-hour subject block. He shares his screen and does all the typing; you guide.

• Break each written assignment into 20-minute chunks, so every session ends with something saved or

submitted.

• Hook his interest through the films and characters he likes, then bridge to the real topic. Right now that

includes superheroes (The Flash, Spider-Man, Batman) and James Cameron's Avatar. Example: why would

a clan living on harsh volcanic land be small and spread out, while a clan near fertile forest and water is

crowded? That is population density. Now compare Singapore with Mongolia. His interests change over

time, so keep asking what he is watching.

• End each day with a 20-minute wrap-up where he shows what got done. Then post a 3-line report in the

family group chat: attended (Y/N), what was completed (with a screenshot), tomorrow's target.

• Send a short weekly summary of progress across all six courses.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

• Write, edit or "fix" his work. Wolsey Hall marks it as his own. No AI-written text goes into anything he

submits.

• Contact him privately (personal chat, phone calls, social media). All communication goes through the family

group chat.

• Ask for his Canvas login. You will see Canvas through his screen share.



IF HE DOES NOT SHOW UP

It will happen sometimes. When it does:

1. At the start time, post in the group chat that you are in the session.

2. At 5 minutes, post again.

3. Wait until 15 minutes. If he is still not there, use the rest of the slot to prepare the next session, and note

the no-show in your report.

You are paid for the scheduled time when you follow these steps. Following up with him is the family's job, not

yours.



WHO YOU ARE

• Licensed Professional Teacher (LET), or a degree in Education or English

• At least 2 years teaching teenagers (13–18), online or in a classroom

• Clear, natural spoken and written English

• Warm but steady: you can encourage him and still hold a line

• You treat a 17-year-old as a young adult. Never "this is easy".

• Reliable setup: laptop, webcam, headset, fibre internet AND a backup (mobile data / power bank / UPS)

• Nice to have: UK or Cambridge curriculum experience (KS3, Lower Secondary, IGCSE), Canvas, Google

Docs



PAY AND TERMS

• USD 7–8 per hour depending on experience (7.5 hours/week)

• Paid every two weeks via Wise or PayPal

OnlineJobs.ph job post · Post 1 of 2 · Lead Learning Coach Page 3

• Shortlisted applicants do a paid 45-minute live trial session, then a paid 1-week trial

• NBI clearance required before starting

• Long-term role for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



1. Begin your application with the word CANVAS.

title: Online Maths & Science Tutor – UK Curriculum Year 9 (Part-Time, Daytime)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read to the end. The application instructions are at the bottom, and applications that skip

them will not be read.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a family in Singapore looking for a patient, creative Maths and Science tutor for a 17-year-old student.

He studies a UK homeschool curriculum (Wolsey Hall Oxford, Lower Secondary Year 9) on the Canvas

platform.



Wolsey Hall's tutors set and mark his work. Your job is to help him understand it, stay with it, and complete his

OWN work. A separate Learning Coach runs his day and covers his other subjects; you work alongside them.

Singapore and the Philippines are in the same time zone, so this is a normal daytime schedule.



SCHEDULE

• Monday to Friday, 1 hour a day (5 hours/week), at a fixed time: 11:20 AM–12:20 PM

• Maths on Monday, Wednesday and Friday; Science on Tuesday and Thursday

• Live video sessions on a Zoom/Google Meet link we provide.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Pick up from the day's targets set by the Learning Coach.

• Explain each concept step by step, then have him try. He shares his screen and does the working; you

guide.

• Break each assignment into 20-minute chunks, so every session ends with something saved or submitted.

• Hook his interest through the films and characters he likes, then bridge to the real topic. Right now that

includes superheroes (The Flash, Spider-Man, Batman) and James Cameron's Avatar. Example: how far

does The Flash get in 3 seconds, and what does that tell us about speed = distance ÷ time? His interests

change over time, so keep asking what he is watching.

• After each session, post a 3-line report in the family group chat: attended (Y/N), what was completed (with a

screenshot), next session's target.

• Flag early if a topic needs more time, so the Learning Coach can plan around it.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

• Write, edit or "fix" his work. Wolsey Hall marks it as his own. No AI-written text goes into anything he

submits.

• Contact him privately (personal chat, phone calls, social media). All communication goes through the family

group chat.

• Ask for his Canvas login. You will see Canvas through his screen share.



IF HE DOES NOT SHOW UP

It will happen sometimes. When it does:

1. At the start time, post in the group chat that you are in the session.

2. At 5 minutes, post again.

3. Wait until 15 minutes. If he is still not there, use the rest of the slot to prepare the next session, and note

the no-show in your report.

You are paid for the scheduled time when you follow these steps. Following up with him is the family's job, not

yours.



WHO YOU ARE

• Licensed Professional Teacher (LET) majoring in Mathematics or Science, or a STEM degree

• At least 2 years teaching Maths and/or Science to teenagers (13–18)

• Comfortable teaching BOTH Maths and Science at lower-secondary level (about Grade 8–9)

• Clear spoken English; you can explain without jargon

• Warm but steady: you can encourage him and still hold a line

• You treat a 17-year-old as a young adult. Never "this is easy".

• Reliable setup: laptop, webcam, headset, fibre internet AND a backup (mobile data / power bank / UPS)

• Nice to have: UK or Cambridge curriculum experience (Lower Secondary, IGCSE), a digital whiteboard or

drawing tablet



PAY AND TERMS

• USD 6–7 per hour depending on experience (5 hours/week)

• Paid every two weeks via Wise or PayPal

• Shortlisted applicants do a paid 45-minute live trial session, then a paid 1-week trial

• NBI clearance required before starting

• Long-term role for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



1. Begin your application with the word EQUATION.



2. Include a 2-minute video introducing yourself (unlisted YouTube, Loom or Google Drive link).



3. Answer these in your own words (no AI tools):



- a) He gets stuck on a problem and says, "I'm just bad at maths." What do you say?



- b) Using The Flash or any superhero, explain speed = distance ÷ time to a 17-year-old in 3–5 sentences.



- c) It is 10 minutes past the start time and he has not joined. What do you do?

title: Experienced Linked Ghostwriter
description:
🚀 We're Hiring: LinkedIn Ghostwriters & Copywriters (A-Players Only)



A rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business, work with ambitious clients and be rewarded for exceptional performance.



We're looking for experienced LinkedIn Ghostwriters and LinkedIn Copywriters who genuinely understand how to create content that builds authority, generates engagement and drives business results.



This isn't a role for general content writers or people who have only recently started using LinkedIn.



We're looking for specialists who live and breathe LinkedIn.



🎯 What We're Looking For



You must have proven experience in:



- LinkedIn hooks: Understanding different hook styles, why they work and when to use them.

- Content frameworks: Storytelling, PAS, AIDA, authority-building and other proven writing structures.

- Content funnels: Creating effective TOFU, MOFU and BOFU content for different business objectives.

- LinkedIn strategy: Understanding posting frequencies, content pillars, audience growth and engagement.

- Idea extraction: Taking raw client ideas, voice notes, interviews and research and turning them into outstanding LinkedIn posts.

- Content performance: Knowing how to analyse results, identify what works and continuously improve.



You should be confident taking a client from initial research and idea extraction all the way through to a polished, high-performing LinkedIn post.



⭐ Who We're Looking For



Someone who:



- Has a proven track record of writing successful LinkedIn content.

- Is actively using LinkedIn and understands what's working right now.

- Can demonstrate real results and traction.

- Has a clear, repeatable system for producing quality content.

- Takes ownership, thinks strategically and doesn't need constant direction.

- Has exceptional writing skills and attention to detail.



We want people who can explain not just what they write, but why they write it.



💰 Why Join Us?



This is a rare opportunity to join a growing business with serious ambitions.



We're building a high-performing team and want exceptional people to grow with us.



What we offer:



- Competitive salary based on experience and ability.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Salary increases for exceptional results.

- Opportunities for career progression and greater responsibility.

- The chance to work with ambitious businesses and personal brands.

- A team that values expertise, initiative and high standards.



We're willing to pay more for the right person. If you're an A-player, we want to reward you like one.



📩 How to Apply



We don't want a generic CV and cover letter.



To be considered, please provide these 4 things:



1. Your LinkedIn Profile



A direct link to your personal LinkedIn account so we can see your activity and understanding of the platform.



2. Your Portfolio



Examples of LinkedIn posts you've written, ideally with performance results.



We're happy for client work to be anonymised.



3. Your Content Creation System



Show us how you take research, raw ideas, voice notes or client conversations and turn them into finished LinkedIn posts.



This can be a document, workflow, Loom recording or real example.



We want to see how you think and work.



### 4. A 1–2 Minute Video Introduction



Introduce yourself, tell us about your LinkedIn experience, share a result you're proud of and explain why you're an A-player.



No professional editing required.



⚠️ Please Note



This is a specialist role for experienced LinkedIn writers.



Applications without all four requirements will not be considered.



We're not looking for average. We're looking for people who take pride in being exceptional at what they do.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply now and be part of something that's growing.

- 13th month pay.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Growing brands rarely break at the idea or the ad. They break in the middle: the order that ships late, the handoff that nobody owned, the warehouse that raised its rates, the process everyone assumes someone else is running. Every new market, product, and launch adds more of that middle, and the brands that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns the middle. You’ll make sure the whole business runs well, from the moment a customer orders to the moment the box arrives. You’ll build the systems, clear the path for the people doing the work, and run the network of fulfillment partners behind every order: knowing who’s out there, keeping the conversations open, and negotiating so our costs keep coming down. For a sharp, driven operator who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build and maintain our 3PL network. Keep a living map of fulfillment partners across the markets we serve: who they are, where they ship from, what they handle, what they charge, and how they perform. Know who to call before we need them.



Negotiate all the time, not once a year. Stay in constant conversation with new and existing 3PLs, open negotiations, compare offers, and use each one to push rates, terms, and service levels in our favor. Every point you win drops straight into our margin.



Keep the whole business running. Own the day-to-day operations across fulfillment, customer support, vendors, and internal processes, and make sure nothing important falls between teams.



Build the systems that scale. Turn the way we work into clear processes, checklists, and tools that a growing team can follow without being told twice.



Make teams work as one. Connect marketing, creative, support, and logistics so that work moves smoothly from one hand to the next and blockers get cleared fast.



Own our other partners. Manage the relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and service providers: performance, costs, contracts, and what happens when something goes wrong.



Run on real numbers. Track the operational numbers that matter, such as delivery times, cost per order, error rates, and margins, and turn them into decisions and savings.



Solve problems before they spread. Catch the small issue early, find the real cause, and fix it permanently, so the same thing doesn’t happen twice.



Keep the team in rhythm. Run a steady working rhythm for a remote, international team, including planning, follow-ups, onboarding, and clear ownership of every task.



Prepare for what’s next. Plan the operations behind new launches, new markets, and new brands before they arrive, so growth doesn’t become chaos.



Keep us in good standing. Make sure we follow the rules that apply to what we make and sell in every market, and that records and contracts are in order.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up research, reporting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



A negotiator’s mindset. You’re comfortable asking for more, you do your homework before you sit down, and you can tell a good offer from one that only looks good. You build relationships that survive hard bargaining.



Systems thinking. You see how the pieces of a business connect, you can tell a one-off problem from a broken process, and you fix the process.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when things go wrong, make sound calls with incomplete information, and explain them clearly.



Fluency with numbers. You’re comfortable with costs, margins, and operational metrics, and you use them to d
, not just to report. You can compare fulfillment quotes line by line and spot what’s hiding in the fine print.



Leadership without hierarchy. You get things done through clarity, trust, and follow-through in a small, remote team, not through titles.



Ownership. You treat every process and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [4+] years running operations for an e-commerce or consumer brand, including sourcing, evaluating, and negotiating with 3PLs or similar partners, and managing remote teams, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact across the business. The systems you build and the deals you win touch every team and every customer. You’ll see the whole company run better because of your work.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds how we operate is the person best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
We are hiring for an SEO Specialist to improve website content and on-page SEO across multiple client websites.



Our team uses ChatGPT and other AI tools for first-pass page reviews. Your job is to take that work further: judge the AI's recommendations, catch what it missed or got wrong, research competitors, and write page-specific improvements.



We care more about your judgment, curiosity, and attention to detail than years of traditional SEO experience. You need more than 1 year of relevant experience, and we will train you on our SEO processes.



This is not a keyword research, link building, or technical audit role.



Full-time, 40 hours a week, remote

Long-term role. You will start on an on-page SEO project that runs for the first 4 months.

First month (training) overlap hours: from 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM Mountain Time. The rest of your hours are up to you. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review existing pages and find SEO improvements: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, content structure, and keyword targeting

- Check AI-generated recommendations for accuracy, relevance, and completeness, and catch what the AI missed or got wrong

- Write specific, actionable recommendations based on search intent, the audience, and business goals, and explain your reasoning

- Flag thin, repetitive, outdated, or generic content

- Research competing pages, compare their quality, structure, and depth, and find content gaps

- Work out what searchers are actually trying to accomplish for each topic

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and analysis, write and refine prompts, and verify claims independently

- Find ways to improve visibility in both traditional search and AI-powered search

- Prioritize recommendations by likely value, and add genuinely useful content, not just more content

- Follow our SEO processes, ask questions when something is unclear, and work across multiple client projects



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Sound judgment and critical thinking: you question recommendations instead of accepting them, spot gaps and inconsistencies, and explain your reasoning

- More than 1 year of experience in SEO, content editing, QA, or research

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI/LLM tools, and careful to check and qualify their responses before using them

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Strong online research skills, and you can tell credible information from unsupported claims

- Strong written English and clear, concise explanations

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: AI Ads Graphic Designer
description:
About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.



You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine — you'll own that side of the creative machine.



What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process — creatives that pass review without rework and match the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.



Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output



Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

Compensation & Working Style

Location: 100% remote

Schedule: Fully flexible — work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO — take the time you need, just coordinate with the team

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement; clear process, daily async communication

Compensation: $10 base + results based bonuses on winning ads
