title: Short-Form Reels Video Editor
description:
About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, and our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram. We run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world.

This role exists because we need more of the simple, native-feeling videos that drive our growth — and we need someone with a creator mindset to make them. You don't need to be an expert editor. You need to instinctively know what makes a video work.





Here's the type of video you'll be making: 
/reel/DZj8I9aok7A/





What Success Looks Like

Within your first month, you're consistently turning raw, unpolished footage into simple, scroll-stopping TikToks and Reels — and pitching your own video ideas, not just executing ours. Success is having an opinion on what will perform, being right often, and getting better every week by watching what the numbers say.





Core Responsibilities



Edit TikToks and Reels from raw, unpolished footage — text-on-screen, and simple TikTok native formats

Come up with new video concepts and creative visuals, not just execute given formats

Spot what's working in your own edits and on TikTok, and apply it fast

Iterate based on feedback and performance data

Communicate proactively and daily (async) about output and ideas

Must-Haves



An eye for it — you can watch a set of clips and tell exactly which are good, which aren't, and why

Experience editing TikTok/Reels — including simple text-on-screen videos, not just talking heads

You're a genuine, daily TikTok/Reels consumer — you understand this content natively

Creative opinions — you can look at raw footage and see the visual story that will perform

Comfortable working from rough, unpolished source footage

Proficiency in CapCut

Clear written English and reliable daily communication

Nice-to-Haves



Trend radar — you spot rising audio, text styles, and formats before they peak

Familiarity with TikTok/Instagram analytics — you can read watch time and drop-off data and improve your next edit from it

Not a Fit If



Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You need a finished brief for every video and don't enjoy pitching your own ideas

You don't actually watch short-form content yourself

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Compensation & Working Style



Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Compensation: Competitive base rate + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible — work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO — take the time you need, just coordinate with the team

Growth: We invest in committed people — courses, software, and mentorship

title: Guest Experience Specialist – Short-Term Rentals (Overnight, AI-Savvy)
description:
HOW TO APPLY: complete our application at 
/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

title: Social media posting operator (typing-heavy, no editing) | Part time, 3 hrs/day | $250/mo
description:
Read to the end. Applications that skip the instructions at the bottom will not be considered.



The job



Every working day you receive finished videos and written captions for one public speaker. You post them to YouTube, Instagram,
, Threads, TikTok, X and LinkedIn. There is no editing, no caption writing and no strategy. The job is accuracy and showing up.



The daily session



About 3 hours, starting at 8:00 am GMT+4 (12:00 noon Philippine time), six days a week with one fixed rest day.



- Confirm the posts scheduled in your last session went live, and redo any that failed

- Check each video against its caption before it goes up. Flag anything that looks wrong and skip it.

- Schedule about 37 posts using each platform's own built-in scheduler

- Post TikToks live during the session when instructed

- Update the tracking sheet



Four rules with no exceptions



1. You work through a remote session on our computer. You will never be given a password, and you must not ask for one.

2. Every caption is typed by hand. Paste is disabled on our computer and every session is recorded.

3. No scheduling apps, macros or auto-typers. Built-in platform schedulers only.

4. You never change a caption or a video. Problems are flagged, not fixed.



You must already have



- 60 wpm typing at 97% accuracy in English

- Experience scheduling posts inside YouTube Studio, Meta Business Suite and TikTok Studio

- A connection that holds a 3-hour remote-desktop session, plus a backup connection

- The same hours free every working day



Do not apply if



- You want a creative or social media manager role

- You cannot commit to the same start time every working day

- You plan to subcontract the work



Pay



$250 per month. Rate review at 3 months.



How to apply



Make TYPED the first word of your message. Then answer these, in this order:



1. Your typing speed and accuracy

2. Which platform schedulers you have used, and for how long

3. Your internet speed and your backup connection

4. Your other current jobs and the hours they take

5. Confirm you can start at 8:00 am GMT+4 (12:00 noon Philippine time) six days a week



Shortlisted candidates will have a short Google Meet interview with us, and may be asked to complete a short typing and posting test as part of the evaluation.

title: AI Video Editor for DTC Ad Creatives (UGC, Animation) – Full-Time + Bonuses
description:
We are a creative agency that produces video ads for DTC (e-commerce) brands. We are looking for a full-time video editor who can turn a written brief into a finished ad using AI tools.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Produce short video ads (around 90 seconds each) from a brief and a script.

- Generate images and video clips with AI tools (Google Flow / Veo, Nano Banana) and write the prompts with Claude or ChatGPT.

- Edit in CapCut: cuts, captions, sound effects, music, b-roll.

- Work in different styles: AI UGC (talking head), Pixar-style animation, claymation and 2D.

- Apply corrections quickly when feedback comes in.

- Log your work every day in our tracking sheet.



WHAT WE EXPECT

- 40 hours per week.

- About 13 finished videos per week (around 3 hours per video).

- Good quality first. A rushed video that gets rejected does not count.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Experience editing short-form video ads (TikTok, Reels, Meta ads).

- Good skills in CapCut (or Premiere / DaVinci and willing to use CapCut).

- Experience with AI image and video tools, or proof that you learn new tools fast.

- Good written English to follow briefs and scripts.

- Stable internet and a computer that can handle video editing.

- Reliable communication: you answer messages and you meet deadlines.



PAY AND BONUSES

- Trial month: $350/month base salary for 40 hours per week.

- After you pass the one-month trial: base salary goes up to $500/month.

- Extra output: $15 for every extra 90 seconds of approved video above the weekly target.

- Winner ad bonus: $20 for each video you edit that becomes a winning ad.

- Best ad of the month: $50.

- Team bonus when the team hits the monthly video target.

- Pay is tied to the weekly output target. If you deliver less than the target, the base is reduced in proportion, and rejected videos carry a deduction. We explain the full system before you start.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the words "AI EDITOR" so we know you read this.

2. Send 2 or 3 video ads you edited (links). Tell us which AI tools you used in each one.

3. Tell us how long it takes you to produce a 90-second ad from brief to final export.

4. Tell us your time zone and the hours you can work.



Shortlisted candidates will do a short paid test video.

title: AutoCAD Millwork Drafter
description:
Millwork company is looking for a technically strong AutoCAD Drafter to join our team and work on detailed shop drawings for custom architectural millwork and furniture.



This is not a 3D modeling, rendering, or visualization position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys the technical side of furniture and millwork - understanding how cabinets, built-ins, wall panels, reception desks, and other custom pieces are actually constructed and assembled.



Our work is done primarily in AutoCAD, and our drawings are used directly by our production team to manufacture and install custom millwork.



What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is highly proficient in AutoCAD and has experience with millwork, cabinetry, furniture, or detailed fabrication drawings.

Previous professional millwork drafting experience is strongly preferred. However, we are also interested in technically minded AutoCAD drafters who have a strong understanding of furniture construction and are willing to learn our drafting and production standards.

We have established standards for drawing layouts, details, hatches, hardware, construction methods, and documentation. We will train the right person on how we work.



What matters most is your AutoCAD ability, technical thinking, attention to detail, understanding of construction, and willingness to learn.



Responsibilities

Produce detailed AutoCAD shop drawings for custom millwork and furniture

Create plans, elevations, sections, and fabrication details

Develop drawings that clearly communicate how each piece will be manufactured and assembled

Dimension components accurately for production

Detail materials, hardware, joinery, reveals, clearances, and other construction requirements

Read and interpret architectural drawings and project information

Revise drawings based on redlines and technical feedback

Follow Brooklyn Millwork drafting standards, templates, hatches, and detailing methods

Coordinate technical questions with Project Managers and Production

Prepare organized CAD and PDF drawing packages for review and fabrication

Requirements

Strong AutoCAD proficiency is required

Experience with millwork, cabinetry, furniture, or fabrication drawings

Strong technical and construction-oriented thinking

Ability to understand how something shown on a drawing will actually be built

Ability to read architectural plans, elevations, sections, and details

High attention to dimensions and technical details

Good file organization and drafting discipline

Conversational English for communication with our US-based team

Willingness to learn and follow our drafting standards and construction methods

Strongly Preferred

Previous experience producing millwork or cabinetry shop drawings

Experience working with a cabinet or millwork manufacturer

Understanding of cabinet construction and furniture assembly

Knowledge of hinges, drawer slides, fasteners, and other cabinet hardware

Hands-on furniture fabrication, cabinet assembly, or installation experience

Familiarity with US architectural drawings and standards

Important - Please Read Before Applying



This position is focused on 2D technical AutoCAD drafting.



We are not looking for:

3D modelers

SketchUp specialists

Rendering artists

Interior design visualization

Architectural visualization portfolios



If your portfolio primarily consists of 3D models and renderings, this position is probably not the right fit.



We want to see technical AutoCAD drawings, especially detailed drawings showing how furniture, cabinetry, or millwork is constructed.



What We Offer

Remote position based in the Philippines

Steady pipeline of custom millwork projects

Long-term opportunity

Established AutoCAD drafting standards and templates

Training on our construction methods, hardware, hatches, and drawing standards

Direct collaboration with our US-based Project Management and Production teams

Opportunity to develop specialized expertise in high-end architectural millwork

How to Apply



Please
 your resume and samples of your best technical AutoCAD work to:



Subject line:

AutoCAD Drafter (Remote) + Your First and Last Name



Portfolio Requirements

Please send examples of detailed 2D technical drawings, preferably for:

Millwork

Cabinets

Furniture

Built-ins

Fabrication or manufacturing



Your samples should ideally include plans, elevations, sections, dimensions, and construction details.



Please do not send 3D renderings or SketchUp portfolios. We are evaluating your technical AutoCAD drafting ability.



If you do not have direct millwork experience but have strong technical AutoCAD skills and are genuinely interested in learning furniture and millwork construction, you are still welcome to apply.

We run an in-house performance marketing team out of Cyprus. We buy TikTok Spark ads on CPA offers (reward apps and mobile games) across the DACH region, the Nordics, France, the UK, Poland, Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium, US, Japan and Korea.



We are scaling to seven figures per month. We fund the ad spend, the accounts and the tools. You bring the skill, the discipline and the hours.



Who we want

We're hiring only 1 to 2 people. We want genuinely motivated, disciplined buyers who want to work with us FULL TIME and scale campaigns with us for the long run. This is not a side gig, and it's not for dabblers, course-watchers or people "exploring opportunities". If you're serious and you'll put in the time and dedication, read on.



Earnings

Our buyers make $1,500 to $4,000 per month. Top performers make over $15,000 per month. What you earn depends on what you scale.



What you'll do

- Launch and manage TikTok Spark ad campaigns on CPA offers in multiple markets

- Test new hooks every day, kill losers fast and scale winners step by step

- Keep every ad compliant with TikTok's advertising policies

- Report daily on spend, results, ROAS and what you tested



What you need

- Real, hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience with your own campaigns and results you can prove

- CPA / affiliate experience (reward apps, gaming or app installs is a big plus)

- Strong written English and comfort with the numbers (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM)

- Full-time availability, Mon–Fri, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM Manila time

- Reliable internet, backup power or connection, and your own laptop



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

Any application that does not answer EVERY question below will not get a response. No exceptions. No generic cover letters.



1. Write the keyword SCALEPROOF as the first line of your application.

2. How many years have you been running paid TikTok ads, and in which verticals (CPA/affiliate, reward apps, gaming, ecom)?

3. What is the biggest daily spend you've personally managed on TikTok, and what was the ROAS on it?

4. Attach screenshots of your own TikTok Ads Manager AND the matching affiliate/network dashboard for the same date range. You may blur brand names. NDAs are not an excuse for zero proof. Applicants without proof will not be considered.

5. Send links to 2 or 3 Spark ads you built yourself.

6. In your own words, explain how you test hooks and how you scale a winning ad group.

7. How many hours per week are you available, and what is your timezone? Confirm you can work full time.

What happens next

Shortlisted applicants get a video call with a live screen-share of their TikTok Ads Manager and their network dashboard. No live screen-share, no trial. No exceptions.



If you've read this far and you can tick every box, we want to hear from you.

description:
ABOUT ME AND MY BUSINESS



Hi! I'm Naomi Appelhof, a biblicalcounselor and identity coach. I help women move from insecurity to a strong, God-given identity. I've worked in counseling and care since 2004, and I'm a wife and a mother of three.



My Dutch business is established, with programs, online courses and an engaged community. Now I'm starting something new: building the English-speaking, global side of my ministry and business. That side is still very new, and I'm looking for someone who wants to help build it from the start.



WHAT I NEED HELP WITH



Video editing in Riverside

- Edit podcast episodes, interviews and videos in Riverside

- Make short clips (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from longer recordings

- Add captions, clean up audio and video, and keep everything on brand



Kajabi (advanced, highly experienced)

You know the platform inside out and follow its latest features and updates.

- Set up and maintain courses, communities, landing pages,
 sequences and offers in Kajabi

- Help me decide how to set up the English side of my business in Kajabi, for example how to keep my English community separate from my Dutch community

- Stay on top of new Kajabi features and suggest how we can use them

- Advise on the best structure for the customer journey and the technical setup



Social media content strategy

- Help shape a clear content strategy for the English market (Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube)

- Plan content, suggest themes and formats, and keep track of what works

- Think strategically about growing an international audience



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Skills matter, but the most important thing for me is how you work. I'm looking for someone who:

- Thinks ahead and takes initiative. You don't wait to be told; you see what's coming and act on it.

- Brings ideas. You suggest improvements, new content and smarter ways of working.

- Is open to feedback. You welcome input and use it to keep growing.

- Is organized and structured. You keep track of tasks, files and deadlines, and you communicate clearly.

- Writes and communicates well in English



DON'T HAVE ALL THE SKILLS? PLEASE STILL APPLY!



I know it's rare to find one person who is great at all three: video editing, Kajabi and social media strategy. If you're strong in one or two of these areas, please still reach out to me. Just tell me clearly where your strengths are. For example, you may be excellent in Riverside but not experienced with Kajabi, or the other way around. I'd love to hear from you either way.



FAITH



My work is rooted in my Christian faith, and much of my content is Bible-based. It would be wonderful if you share that faith or feel connected to it, especially for the social media work. It isn't a requirement, but you do need to be open to it and comfortable working with faith-based content.



HOURS AND GROWTH



To be honest about where I am: right now I can't offer a full-time role. To start, this is about 2-3 hours per week, and the hours may vary. My intention is to build a long-term working relationship. As the English side grows, I'd love for this role to grow with it.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience

2. Which of the three areas (Riverside video editing, Kajabi, social media strategy) you are strongest in

3. Examples of your work (edited videos, Kajabi projects, social media strategies or accounts you've managed)

4. Your hourly rate

5. One idea you have for growing a Christian coaching brand on social media



To show me you've read this whole post, please start your message with: "Ready to build something meaningful."



I look forward to hearing from you!

title: HEAD OF PERFORMANCE MARKETING
description:
This is not a media buyer role.



An Australian eCommerce performance agency is looking for a Head of Performance Marketing: someone who is better at performance marketing than our founder. You'll own client ad accounts end to end. You'll find the problems and the opportunities yourself, challenge our thinking, and be accountable for one thing above all: profitable revenue growth.



If you can look at a store's website, products, ad accounts and sales data and explain how that business makes money, and exactly how you'd grow it profitably, keep reading.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Full ownership of client Google and Meta ad accounts: strategy, structure, buying and scaling

- Auditing accounts and building growth plans without being asked

- D
 which products to push, which to hold back, and where traffic should land

- Diagnosing and fixing tracking issues yourself

- Product feeds and Merchant Center

- Working with our content team on creative strategy and testing

- Calls with Australian clients: walking them through results, explaining your decisions, and pushing back when there's a better way





MUST-HAVES

(Please only apply if you meet every one of these.)



- 7–10+ years in performance marketing, with heavy hands-on media buying

- Experience as Head of Paid Media, Performance Lead or Senior Performance Strategist

- Experience working for Australian agencies or major Australian eCommerce brands

- Excellent written and spoken English. You're comfortable leading calls with Australian clients

- A proven record of scaling eCommerce revenue while holding or improving profit, on substantial monthly budgets

- Google Ads: Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, account structure, feed segmentation and scaling

- Tracking: GTM, GA4, server-side tracking, Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions, Merchant Center and feeds, and Shopify conversion tracking. You can diagnose tracking problems without help

- A commercial brain. You think in margins, CAC, ROAS vs MER, AOV and conversion rate, not just platform metrics

- Ownership. You audit, plan and act without being told, and you speak up when you disagree





NICE-TO-HAVES



- You've managed and mentored other media buyers

- UK or US agency experience (especially if your Australian experience is lighter)

THE DETAILS

- A senior role with real ownership. Your strategy, your accounts, your results





HOW TO APPLY

title: Software Developer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You’ll write the software that sits behind the brand: the tools our teams use, the integrations that connect our systems, and the experiences our customers see. You’ll talk to the people who use what you ship, and build the thing that actually fixes their problem, not the thing they first described.



For a sharp, driven engineer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build what the business needs. Work with marketing, creative, operations, and support to find where software can save time, cut errors, or unlock growth, then build it.



Improve the customer experience. Build and refine the features on our store and sites that help customers find, trust, and buy, and keep them fast, reliable, and easy to use on every device. 



Connect our systems. Build and maintain the integrations between our store, fulfillment partners, ad platforms,
, support tools, and analytics, so data flows where it should and nobody retypes anything.



Automate the repetitive work. Find the tasks that eat people’s hours and turn them into scripts, workflows, and tools that run on their own.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Build the data pipelines, tracking, and dashboards that let the team see what’s working, and keep them accurate.



Build with AI. Design and ship features and workflows powered by AI, from tools that speed up our team’s work to experiences that help our customers.



Ship fast, and ship well. Move from idea to production quickly, in small steps, with code that’s tested, readable, and easy for the next person to change.



Keep it secure and running. Handle customer and company data carefully, follow the privacy rules in every market we sell in, and fix what breaks before it affects anyone.



Choose the simple solution. Question every layer of complexity. Pick the right tool for each job, not the most impressive one.



Write it down. Document what you build and how it works, so nothing lives only in your head.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI coding tools to speed up design, implementation, testing, and documentation, then apply your own judgment to make sure the result is correct, secure, and maintainable.



What we look for



Strong fundamentals. You write clean, correct code, understand how the pieces of a system fit together, and can reason your way through a problem you haven’t seen before.



Pragmatism. You ship the simplest thing that works well, and you improve it with real feedback instead of building for imaginary needs.



Product sense. You care who uses what you build. You ask good questions, notice when the request isn’t the real problem, and test your work against reality.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when something breaks, find the real cause quickly, and keep people informed while you fix it.



Clear communication. You can explain technical things to non-technical people in plain words, and your written updates leave no one guessing.



Ownership. You treat every system you build as yours until it works for the people using it. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [3+] years building and shipping production software, with strong skills across the front end and back end. Experience integrating with third-party APIs and working with data is essential. Experience in e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. What you build goes live fast and is used by real people right away. You’ll see the whole company work better because of it.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the engineer who builds our foundations is the person best placed to lead the team behind them.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link:

The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.

title: GTA 6 Gameplay Recorder
description:
We are looking for reliable and experienced GTA 5 players to record high-quality gameplay footage from GTA 6.



Your job is simple: **we provide the scenes and instructions, you record the gameplay and send us the raw footage.**



You will NOT need to edit videos, create thumbnails, write scripts, or record voiceovers.



We are looking for people interested in a long-term collaboration.



## Responsibilities



- Record GTA 6 gameplay following our detailed scene lists.

- Capture specific missions, vehicles, locations, characters, interactions, and gameplay moments.

- Record 2–3 different takes of each requested scene whenever necessary.

- Follow instructions carefully to capture the exact shots we need.

- Organize and name all files according to our instructions.

- Upload original, unedited footage to Google Drive.

- Occasionally test specific gameplay mechanics or scenarios.

- Complete most assignments within 24–48 hours.



## Requirements



- Own a PS5, PS5 Pro, or Xbox Series X/S capable of running GTA 6.

- Have access to GTA 6 when assignments begin.

- Experience playing GTA games, preferably GTA V or GTA Online.

- Ability to record gameplay at a minimum of 1080p / 60 FPS.

- 1440p or 4K recording is a plus.

- Clean gameplay recordings without microphone audio, facecam, notifications, or external overlays.

- In-game radio and copyrighted music must be disabled.

- No mods or cheats unless specifically requested.

- Reliable internet connection for uploading large video files.

- Good communication and ability to follow detailed instructions.



A capture card is a plus, but not mandatory if your console recording setup produces high-quality footage.



## Payment



**We pay $1 USD per minute of the final edited YouTube video, NOT per minute of raw recorded footage.**



Examples:



- 10-minute final video = $10 USD

- 15-minute final video = $15 USD

- 20-minute final video = $20 USD



You may need to record additional footage and multiple takes to complete an assignment. We will provide a scene list and agree on the approximate final video length before you start.





## How to Apply



Please include the following information:



1. Which console do you own? (PS5 / PS5 Pro / Xbox Series X/S)

2. Do you have a capture card, or do you use your console's built-in recording?

3. What is your experience with GTA V, GTA Online, or GTA 6?

4. How many hours per day are you available?

5. What is your internet upload speed?



**Important:** Start your application with the words "GTA RECORDER" so we know you have read the entire description.



We are looking for reliable people who can consistently deliver high-quality gameplay footage and grow with our team.

title: Sales Virtual Assistant — Cold Calling & Lead Conversion for Residential and Commercial Cleaning
description:
Cado Premier Cleaning Group provides residential and commercial cleaning in the Indianapolis area. We're growing, and we need a closer. Someone who picks up the phone, calls people back fast, and turns inquiries into booked cleanings. This is a sales job first. You'll call new leads, follow up until they d
, and get property managers to say yes to a walkthrough and a quote.



Schedule and pay

20 paid hours per week. Proposed coverage: Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m. Indianapolis time (America/Indiana/Indianapolis, Eastern Time). Final hours will be agreed before starting. A mutually agreed split shift is possible. No monitoring is expected outside paid coverage. Required training, meetings and administration are paid. Initial paid trial: 30 calendar days.

Base pay is $5 USD/hour. Bonuses: $5 for a new one-time residential client's first completed and paid job; $10 for a new recurring client's first completed and paid visit; $10 for an attended qualified commercial walkthrough; and another $25 after a new commercial account's first invoice is paid. Written eligibility rules apply; bonuses are not guaranteed.



What you will do

• Call new leads fast, during coverage hours — Yelp, Thumbtack, Google-origin leads, Nextdoor,
, website forms and the business phone. Speed matters. Most jobs go to whoever calls back first.

• Follow up until they book or say no. Most people don't book on the first call. You'll call, text and
, keep every lead warm, and never let one go quiet.

• Cold call property managers, apartment complexes, offices and short-term rental managers. Pitch our turnover and commercial cleaning, get them to accept a quote, and book a walkthrough.

• Present quotes with confidence and close the booking — standard, deep, move-out or recurring. Handle "I need to think about it" and price objections without being pushy.

• Ask about size, rooms, condition, priorities and extras; prepare approved routine quotes or refer exceptions to the owner.

• Maintain clear CRM notes, coordinate with existing automations and give the owner a short daily handoff: what's booked, what's pending, and what's next.

What we are looking for

A closer, not just a communicator. You've sold on the phone before — home services, cleaning or something similar — and you're comfortable hearing no and calling back anyway. Clear spoken and written English, good listening, reliable follow-through, and comfort with business phone and CRM tools. You need a suitable computer, headset, quiet calling space and dependable internet. We assess understandable communication and judgment, not accent imitation.



How to apply

Apply through this listing with your resume, country/time zone, Indianapolis-time availability and answers to the screening questions. Include a 45–60 second voice introduction and a short explanation of why a deep clean differs from standard cleaning. Also tell us about one time you turned a "let me think about it" into a yes. Tell us if you need an alternative submission format. Finalists will be offered a paid practical exercise.

title: Senior PPC Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
This is not a campaign-execution job. As a Senior PPC Manager you grow brands, oversee client accounts, and lead the way our team works with AI: building the tools and processes that take over repetitive work, and making sure what they produce is right. We are looking for someone who thinks, sees the bigger picture, and makes the whole team better.



🟢About Growster⚫️

Growster is a boutique Amazon growth agency based in Germany, founded by former aggregator brand owners. We work with 7- and 8-figure brands in the EU, UK and US. Our PPC Managers are also the account managers: they own the account and the client relationship. And we are moving our whole way of working to AI-assisted workflows that our own team designs, builds and checks.



🔘What you will do

✦Own a portfolio of brands end to end: growth, profit, margin, TACOS and the P&L, not only the ad console.

✦Go beyond bid management. Connect PPC with organic rank, listing, images, CTR, CVR, pricing, stock and promotions, and flag when the problem is not PPC at all.

✦Design and build AI-assisted tools and processes that optimize our workflows and improve the ones we already have, and get the team using them.

✦Oversee accounts with a sharp eye. Check AI output before it reaches a client or an account, correct what is wrong, and own the result.

✦Put analysis, prevention and growth ahead of busywork: spot problems before they show up in the numbers, fix the cause, and add a check so it does not happen again.

✦Lead client communication: clear, proactive and honest, including client calls, decisions and hard news. Share wins, problems and plans before the client asks.

✦Work as part of the team and raise its level: help teammates do things on their own, mentor newer PPC managers, share what you learn and build, and disagree openly and constructively. This matters as much as your own results.

🔘The person we are looking for

✦Analytical. You start from the data and you know which numbers matter.

✦High-agency. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

✦Holistic. You think about the whole brand, not one channel.

✦AI-sharp. You build with AI and you catch it when it is wrong.

✦Honest. You say what is really happening, to the client and to us, including your own mistakes.

✦Collaborative and coachable. You make the people around you better, and you take feedback well.

🔘Who we are not looking for

🚫Checklist-only operators who follow steps without asking why.

🚫Yes-men. We want people who push back with reasons.

🚫Siloed specialists who only look at the ad console.

🚫Vanity-metric chasers who report impressions while profit slips.

🚫People who measure their value in hours and task lists. We do not need a daily "here is everything I did" report. We need the right things done and the wrong things prevented.

🚫Relays for AI. If you pass on what an AI says without checking it, this is not the role for you: every output that reaches a client or an account is yours.

🚫Part-time or freelance arrangements. This role is full-time.

🔘What success looks like after 6 months

✦You run a portfolio of brands end to end, and the clients see measurable growth.

✦At least one AI-assisted tool or process you built is used by the whole team.

✦Problems on your accounts are caught and prevented before clients notice them.

✦Teammates and clients come to you as a trusted voice.

What you bring

✦3+ years owning Amazon accounts, with growth you can prove: case studies with numbers, ideally on 7- or 8-figure brands.

✦AI workflows or tools you built (with Claude, ChatGPT, automations, scripts or sheets) that changed how you or your team work, and how you check what they produce.

✦Analytical depth: Search Query Performance, search-term and placement data, bulk files, spreadsheets, and P&L thinking (break-even ACOS, TACOS, margin).

✦Strong command of the levers around PPC: SEO and keywords, listing and image content, pricing, inventory and profitability.

✦Excellent written and spoken client communication in English.

What we offer

✦Full-time and fully remote, with flexible hours judged on results. We need a working overlap with German business hours for team and client calls.

✦A lean team that builds and shares its own AI tools.

How to apply

✦The application takes 45 minutes to 1.5 hours. It is deliberately thorough, so please set aside the time.

✦Record a 5-minute intro video (Loom or similar) covering: who you are and which role you are applying for, why Growster, and your experience (challenges, meaningful projects, where you want to grow).

✦Take the IQ Test 
 and keep a screenshot of your score. It is information we collect, never a pass or fail filter.

✦Fill in the application form at 
 and upload your resume as a PDF.

❗️About AI and writing. Some questions ask you to work with your preferred AI tool; for those, paste the whole chat, because how you steer and check the AI is what we look at. Everywhere else, write in your own words. Voice-to-text such as Wispr Flow is fine, but avoid using any grammar correction function from these tools.

✦Applications sent any other way than the form are not reviewed. It is the first test of reading instructions. Do not use any polish/grammar correction in your responses aside from AI tasks❗️

Our process

✦Application (above). We review within 5 business days.

✦Audit test, 3 to 5 hours: an integrated audit of an anonymized account covering PPC, listing health, Search Query Performance and P&L. Materials provided.

✦Interview, 60 to 90 minutes: you walk us through your audit as if we were the client, and we talk about how you work with a team.

✦Final interview and offer.

✦End to end this usually takes 2 to 3 weeks. No unpaid trial work on live accounts, no personality tests, no coding tests, no reference calls.

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
First things first...

This is a 100% remote position that requires 0–10% travel and has a salary range of 1,700-1,900/month USD, plus 13th-month pay. This is a full-time, monthly salaried position. You will be required to work Central Standard Time business hours. 



We are looking for a seasoned accounting professional who can take ownership of daily accounting operations, confidently solve problems, and deliver accurate financials with minimal oversight. 



Does working on a variety of projects, contributing to different types of workflows, never having the same day twice in a row sound exciting to you? Are you a financial wizard with a passion for precision and a love for meaningful work? Us too.. That’s why we started Atomus Partners!



If you're ready to elevate your career in accounting, we have an exciting opportunity that awaits you!



What We Do

Atomus -- the Latin word for atoms, which are the basic building blocks of the universe. At Atomus Partners, we operate as a back-office nucleus, allowing the organization to focus on what it does best - its core business. We remove the common challenges small and medium-sized businesses often struggle with in developing, growing, and maintaining a highly functional back office (HR, Administrative, Finance/Accounting, IT), and help them to see beyond today.



What You’ll Do

Reporting to our Accounting Manager, our Senior Bookkeeper will independently manage day-to-day accounting operations, take ownership of month-end close activities, and ensure accurate, review-ready financial reporting. Your days will be filled with:



Client and Team Support:

• Independently manage accounting deliverables and collaborate with the Accounting Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting and dependable service. 

• Maintain organized files, ensure deliverables are complete and on time, and support the Accounting Manager in executing key initiatives throughout the year. 

• Work alongside cross-functional partners and external vendors to ensure smooth payroll processing, accurate reporting, and successful year-end preparation. 

• Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients, participating in calls, proactively following up on outstanding items, and resolving routine accounting questions. 



Financial Mastery:

• Manage day-to-day activity in QuickBooks Online including transaction coding, accounts payable and receivable workflows, and maintaining clean, organized ledgers. 

• Perform bank and credit card reconciliations, review activity for accuracy, and ensure accounts are supported and properly documented. Independently prepare and post adjusting journal entries such as accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and depreciation. 



Balance Sheet Ownership:

• Own the review and reconciliation of balance sheet accounts to ensure completeness and accuracy. Identify variances or unusual patterns, independently research and resolve discrepancies, and escalate complex issues to the Accounting Manager with proposed solutions. 

• Maintain schedules and take ownership of month-end close processes, ensuring financial statements are accurate, complete, and ready for Accounting Manager review. 



Process Enhancement:

• Identify opportunities to streamline existing workflows, improve documentation, and reduce manual steps.

• Bring forward ideas and participate in projects to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in the accounting function.



What will make you successful in this role (skills)

• Excellent English, written and verbal skills required.

• Accounting education preferred.

• Proven Expertise: With at least 5 years of full-cycle US bookkeeping experience, fully utilizing GAAP accounting, you have strong skills in financial reporting, accurate reconciliations, and independently reviewing and analyzing balance sheets and financial statements to identify and resolve discrepancies before final review. 

• Technical Proficiency: You are tech-savvy, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in QuickBooks Online and strong expertise in Excel. You skillfully navigate multiple internal systems to manage time efficiently and ensure seamless client communication, and deliverables.

• Experience with accounts payable platforms such as 
, Ramp, or Melio; experience with Xero is a plus.

• Success in leveraging task management systems to stay organized, manage deadlines, and maintain clear priorities.

• Extreme Attention to Detail: Attention to detail is so important in what we do every day. So much, that we want to make sure you read this posting in its entirety. When you submit your resume, there will be a question that says “Please include any additional information that you feel has not been previously covered”, please enter your favorite color here.

• Accounting Judgment: Strong understanding of how transactions impact the financial statements, with the ability to identify unusual balances, research discrepancies, and determine appropriate accounting treatment without step-by-step guidance. 

• Integrity and Confidentiality: Uphold the highest ethical standards, ensuring confidentiality of sensitive financial information.

• Communication Extraordinaire: Your clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, set the stage for effective client interactions. You are confident in communicating directly with U.S.-based professionals, asking thoughtful questions, and clearly explaining accounting matters. 

• Multi-Tasking Maven: Thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and deadlines with finesse.

• Independent Initiative: Demonstrated ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities, proactively identify and resolve issues, meet deadlines without constant follow-up, and deliver accurate, complete work with minimal oversight. 

• Collaborative Champion: Your collaborative spirit and positive attitude make you an invaluable team player.

• Continuous Improvement Advocate: Embrace change and champion process enhancements, keeping up with evolving client and organizational needs.



Why Us?

Working at Atomus Partners means living our core values: Commit to Quality, Create Solutions, Collaborate as One, Cultivate Raving Fans, and Climb Higher. You will be challenged daily to develop solutions. Atomus Partners is not for those who just want to clock in, go through the motions, and clock out, as you’ll learn more and grow in 1 year than in 3-5 years at other companies. If you share our core values and liked what you read on this job posting, please apply.



What is in store for you:

Collaborative team culture in a dynamic working environment

Medical insurance reimbursement for the employee and one dependent

20 Leave credits consumed at your discretion

Talent engagement & development programs

WFH arrangement



How to Apply:

• Please submit your application here with a direct link to your CV/Resume.

• Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include your favorite color in the subject line of your application message.

• Note: Applications without a CV link/unavailable CV link and the correct subject line will not be considered.

We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself:

Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.

Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.

Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.

That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.

title: Senior Amazon Brand Manager & Agency Operations Lead
description:
Remote | $15–$25 USD per hour + sales commission



ShopHowell is a boutique ecommerce agency helping brands grow through marketplace strategy, advertising, content, and account management. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of brand performance, lead coordinated execution, and help shape how our agency operates.



Strong hands-on Amazon US experience is essential. Experience with Walmart Marketplace and TikTok Shop is a strong advantage as we expand across platforms.



You’ll work directly with our founder and a team of specialists. Brand management is central to the role, with broader agency operations responsibilities available to someone who can also build the systems behind consistent delivery.



Brand strategy, listing excellence, and execution



Our listings should stand alongside the strongest in their categories—with distinctive brand voice, persuasive copy, thoughtful creative, and polished design. You should recognize exceptional work, explain what makes it effective, and guide the team toward that standard.



You’ll be responsible for:



Developing thoughtful brand strategies. Understand each brand’s audience, positioning, products, and competitive advantages. Use customer reviews, competitor research, search behavior, and account data to identify opportunities and establish clear priorities.



Owning listing quality. Develop, refine, and critically review copy so it is accurate, persuasive, and true to the brand. Every headline, bullet, and content section should serve a clear purpose.



Directing creative work. Guide our designers through clear briefs and specific feedback on listing images, infographics, A+ content, and other brand assets. Connect messaging, visual hierarchy, and product storytelling to customer needs.



Leading execution. Coordinate PPC, listing, creative, and troubleshooting specialists around shared priorities, clear responsibilities, and deadlines. Identify gaps and follow work through to completion.



Evaluating performance methodically. Assess traffic, conversion, sales, advertising efficiency, and inventory constraints. Form clear hypotheses, prioritize improvements, and measure results through structured testing where available.



Keeping clients and leadership informed. Communicate performance, recommendations, risks, and next steps clearly. Stay current on marketplace changes and turn relevant developments into practical action.



Building agency operations — expanded scope



Candidates with proven operations ability can also help build the infrastructure that keeps ShopHowell coordinated as it grows. This includes creating core systems and workflows from the ground up.



Responsibilities will include:



Design and connect CRM, project-management, reporting, and documentation systems, with reliable handoffs from sales through onboarding and ongoing account management.



Establish clear ownership, deadlines, quality standards, and accountability across brands and platforms, including coordination with Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop specialists.



Build practical workflows and automations, guide team adoption, and improve visibility into capacity, outstanding commitments, and delivery bottlenecks.



Qualifications and experience



Required



Hands-on experience working in Amazon US Seller Central, with meaningful responsibility for brand performance or listing optimization on live accounts.



A portfolio demonstrating excellent English-language listing copy, brand judgment, and creative direction, with a clear explanation of your personal contribution.



Strong understanding of keyword research, customer and competitor analysis, product positioning, and conversion-focused content.



Ability to interpret commercial performance data and work confidently with spreadsheets and relevant research and reporting tools.



Excellent written and spoken English for editing copy, communicating with clients, and giving constructive feedback.



Evidence of independent ownership: identifying opportunities, making sound recommendations, coordinating contributors, and following through on results.



Preferred



Experience managing multiple brands or client accounts in an ecommerce agency.



Hands-on experience with Walmart Marketplace or TikTok Shop.



For the expanded agency operations scope, candidates must also demonstrate experience building systems and workflows, introducing them to a team, and showing how they improved coordination or delivery.



Exceptional Amazon listing specialists with strong strategic judgment and the ability to grow into broader brand leadership are encouraged to apply. We place significant weight on work quality, ownership, and demonstrated results.



Compensation



Base pay is $15–$25 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated ability, independence, and agreed responsibilities. The highest end of the range is intended for someone who can own both brand management and broader agency operations.



You’ll also earn commission calculated as a percentage of sales revenue from the brands you manage. The percentage and calculation terms will be agreed before starting.



How to apply



Please include your résumé or professional profile, country and time zone, availability, desired hourly rate, and a brief summary of your platform experience.



Also share:



Two or three of your strongest English-language listing examples. Explain your contribution, the reasoning behind key decisions, and any measurable results. For performance claims, include the timeframe and other factors that may have influenced the outcome.



An example of initiative. Describe a problem or opportunity you identified and acted on without being asked.



An operations example, if applicable. Explain what existed beforehand, what you built, how the team adopted it, and what improved.



Work samples are an essential part of our evaluation. We’re looking for thoughtful decisions, strong execution, and clear evidence of your contribution. Anonymized examples are welcome.

title: DTC Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Remote | Full Time | CST 



How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience in e-commerce operations, inventory management, reporting, and marketplace administration. Answers to the questions below are also required. 



We are a growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce business operating across multiple online sales channels and retail marketplaces. Our operations cover online sales, product management, inventory, order fulfillment, and customer support. We value accuracy, accountability, and individuals who take ownership of their work in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.



About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and analytical DTC Operations Reporting Specialist to support our e-commerce reporting, inventory, fulfillment, and administrative operations.



You will work closely with the Operations team and external business partners to maintain accurate sales reports, inventory records, marketplace listings, and warehouse documentation. The role also involves investigating discrepancies, coordinating fulfillment-related concerns, supporting customer inquiries, and maintaining operational processes. Experience working with DTC brands, marketplace sellers, e-commerce agencies, or aggregators is highly relevant.



Key Responsibilities

- Prepare daily sales reports and recurring marketing and advertising performance reports using information from relevant business systems.

- Consolidate and review operational data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across reports and records.

- Monitor inventory information across the company's direct-to-consumer website, marketplaces, and retail sales channels.

- Maintain product listings, inventory files, and product catalogs across platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and other retailer portals.

- Review marketplace inventory files and product information against approved records before submitting updates or uploads.

- Investigate discrepancies involving sales figures, inventory quantities, order transactions, and fulfillment records, and coordinate with relevant parties to resolve them.

- Coordinate with external warehouse and fulfillment partners regarding inventory counts, shipments, receiving records, returns, and other operational concerns.

title: AI Video Creator & Animator for Cinematic Football Brainrot Content (Long-Term)
description:
About the Project



We are a content production team specializing in AI-generated football entertainment videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.



We are looking for a highly skilled AI Video Creator who can join our production workflow and help us create high-quality, realistic, cinematic AI videos.



This is not a typical video editing job. We need someone who understands AI image generation, image-to-video animation, character consistency, storytelling, character interactions, sound design, and short-form content production.



Our goal is to produce entertaining, highly engaging football-themed Brainrot videos with professional visuals, creative storytelling, and strong viral potential.



1. Our Content Style



Our videos feature famous football players such as:



- Cristiano Ronaldo

- Neymar Jr.

- Kylian Mbappé

- Lionel Messi

- Lamine Yamal



We also use fictional and original characters, especially our signature wooden mascot character, Sahur (Tung Tung).



Our content combines football culture with absurd comedy, internet Brainrot humor, cinematic storytelling, and unexpected situations.



Here are examples of the stories and concepts we produce:



- Crazy pranks between football players and fictional characters.

- Funny interactions and arguments between famous football players.

- Unexpected challenges, competitions, and transformations.

- Unusual friendships, rivalries, and emotional stories.

- Characters getting into ridiculous or surprising situations.

- Creative storylines with unexpected twists and entertaining endings.



For example, Sahur and Neymar might secretly plan a prank on Cristiano Ronaldo, leading to a series of funny reactions and unexpected events.



The storytelling should feel entertaining, unpredictable, and visually exciting.



2. Visual Style & Quality



Visual quality is extremely important to us.



We are looking for:



- Realistic, high-quality AI-generated characters.

- Cinematic 3D visuals with realistic textures and lighting.

- Detailed environments and backgrounds.

- Professional camera angles and cinematic compositions.

- Natural facial expressions and body movements.

- Realistic character interactions.

- Consistent character appearance across different scenes.



IMPORTANT: We are NOT looking for basic cartoon animations, low-quality AI videos, slideshow-style videos, or generic AI-generated clips.



We want realistic, cinematic visuals that look professionally produced.



3. Character Consistency



One of the most important requirements is character consistency.



The same character must maintain the same facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout the entire video.



For example, if Cristiano Ronaldo appears in the first scene, he must look like the same character in every following scene.



Our original Sahur character must also maintain its established design and appearance across all scenes.



Characters should interact naturally with each other rather than appearing as disconnected AI-generated clips.



4. AI Video Production Responsibilities



You will be responsible for helping us produce videos from the initial creative concept to the final edited version.



Your responsibilities include:



A. AI Image Generation



- Generate high-quality cinematic images for individual scenes.

- Create realistic characters and environments.

- Follow visual references and creative instructions.

- Maintain consistent characters across scenes.

- Use appropriate camera angles, lighting, and compositions.



B. Image-to-Video Animation



- Transform generated images into high-quality video clips.

- Create realistic movements, gestures, and facial expressions.

- Animate characters walking, running, talking, reacting, laughing, fighting, and interacting.

- Ensure smooth and natural movements.

- Follow specific camera movement instructions.

- Avoid visual glitches, distorted faces, extra limbs, and unnatural animation.



C. Character Dialogue & Interaction



- Create scenes where characters communicate naturally.

- Synchronize character movements with dialogue where supported.

- Generate or integrate suitable character voices.

- Ensure characters react appropriately during conversations.

- Avoid frozen characters or static scenes when movement and interaction are required.



D. Sound Design



- Add appropriate sound effects for actions and reactions.

- Use background music that matches the emotional tone of each scene.

- Include comedy sounds, impact sounds, transitions, and environmental audio.

- Balance dialogue, music, and sound effects professionally.



E. Final Video Editing



- Assemble all generated scenes into one complete video.

- Maintain engaging pacing and smooth transitions.

- Add subtitles or captions when required.

- Synchronize dialogue, sound effects, and music.

- Deliver a polished final video ready for publication.



5. Video Specifications



Our typical video requirements are:



- Duration: approximately 60–90 seconds.

- Format: Vertical 9:16.

- Platforms: TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

- Language: English dialogue and voice-overs.

- Visual quality: Realistic, cinematic, high-quality AI visuals.

- Storytelling: Fast-paced, entertaining, and engaging.

- Strong opening hook within the first 1–2 seconds.

- Clear story progression with interesting character interactions.

- Unexpected or entertaining endings.



Most videos contain multiple short scenes. The number and duration of scenes depend on the storyline and editing requirements.



We prioritize retention, visual variety, and storytelling quality.



6. Tools & Technical Skills



We are open to different AI production tools, but you should have strong experience with modern AI image and video generation platforms.



Experience with tools such as the following is a plus:



- Grok

- Google Veo

- Kling AI

- Runway

- Midjourney

- Flux

- Nano Banana

- Other advanced AI image and video generation tools.



You do not need to use every tool listed above. What matters most is your ability to deliver the required visual quality and consistent results.



7. Working Process



Our team will provide:



- Creative concepts and story ideas.

- Story direction and scene requirements.

- Character references.

- Visual references and examples of our existing content.

- Detailed instructions for the required style and production quality.



You will be responsible for translating these instructions into high-quality AI-generated scenes and complete videos.



We already have an established creative direction and production workflow. We need someone who can understand our style, follow our references, and consistently reproduce the required quality while also bringing creative ideas when appropriate.



8. What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate should:



- Have a strong portfolio of AI-generated videos.

- Understand cinematic AI image and video production.

- Be experienced with realistic character animation.

- Know how to maintain character consistency.

- Understand storytelling and short-form video pacing.

- Have good sound design and editing skills.

- Be detail-oriented and able to follow creative instructions.

- Communicate clearly and deliver projects on time.

- Be interested in a long-term working relationship.



Previous experience creating AI football videos, Brainrot content, or viral TikTok videos is a significant advantage.



9. Test Project & Long-Term Collaboration



We are looking to build a long-term relationship with the right creator.



We will initially start with a paid test project to evaluate your production skills, creativity, visual quality, and ability to follow our established style.



If the test project meets our expectations, we would like to establish regular collaboration with ongoing video production.



10. How to Apply



When applying, please answer the following questions:



1. Have you previously created realistic AI-generated videos featuring famous football players or fictional characters?

2. Can you create consistent characters across multiple scenes?

3. Which AI image generation and video animation tools do you use?

4. Can you handle the complete production process, including image generation, animation, dialogue, sound effects, and final editing?

5. Have you created content specifically for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or Instagram Reels?

6. How long does it typically take you to produce a complete 60–90 second video?



Please include at least 2–3 examples of your best AI video work.



We are particularly interested in creators who can demonstrate realistic character animation, natural interactions, cinematic visuals, and engaging storytelling.



We are not simply looking for someone who knows how to use AI tools. We are looking for a creative production partner who can help us consistently produce high-quality AI football entertainment content.



If you believe you can reproduce this style and meet our quality standards, we would love to hear from you.

title: Audit & Accounting Associate

LWA LLP is a US-based accounting firm committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture. We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that attitude is just as important as technical skills, if not more important. We strive to create an environment where team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow. You'll join our audit team in the role directly below our Senior Accountant on the audit track, and you'll report to the Senior. You'll help plan and carry out audits, prepare workpapers, and draft financial statements, with review and guidance from the Senior. You'll also work on accounting and bookkeeping projects and on AI-assisted analysis projects using Claude.

Key Responsibilities:



Audit & Review Support

• Prepare audit and review workpapers and supporting schedules

• Assist with testing transactions, balances, and internal controls

• Follow firm audit methodologies and engagement timelines

• Communicate with clients to request records and supporting information



Accounting & Bookkeeping Review

• Review bookkeeping records for accuracy and completeness

• Analyze financial statements and general ledger activity

• Work with both cash basis accounting and accrual basis accounting

• Identify discrepancies, unusual transactions, and needed adjustments

• Assist with month-end close and year-end close procedures

• Recommend corrections and improvements to accounting processes



Financial Reporting

• Prepare and review financial statements and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and trend analysis

• Assist with adjusting journal entries and reclassifications



Requirements:



• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field preferred

• 1–3 years of public accounting, audit, or bookkeeping experience preferred

• Strong Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, and financial schedules)

• Experience with accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero, or similar is a plus)

• Familiarity with cash basis and accrual basis accounting

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple client engagements and deadlines

• Good written and verbal English communication skills



Preferred:



• Public accounting experience

• CPA track or CPA eligibility

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment



This is a full-time remote position (40 hours per week). We value accuracy, accountability, and professionalism.



Please include “LWA Audit Associate” in your application message so we know you read the full posting.
