title: Video Editor
description:
One-Time Gig: Video Creator for a Cinematic Drama-Style Ad



This is a one-time gig for a single video, and it is not an ongoing role or a full-time position. We are a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand looking for a video creator or small team who can produce one story-driven drama ad that matches the quality of the reference video below. If your work looks like a short film rather than a typical ad, we would like to hear from you.



Reference video: 



What the video looks like



The reference is a 7 to 8 minute vertical (9:16) short film that tells an emotional story about a woman who feels overlooked as she ages, with the product introduced naturally partway through. It has multiple characters with scripted dialogue and moves across several locations, including a restaurant, a retail counter, a family home, and a hotel in Paris. The lighting is warm and cinematic, the acting is believable, and the subtitles are clean and burned in. The pacing keeps viewers watching for the full length, which is the main reason this format works.



Gig scope



Production of one complete drama ad of similar length, quality, and emotional tone, built around a script we will provide or develop together with you.

Photorealistic visuals with consistent characters across every scene, whether you film live or use AI video tools such as Veo, Kling, or Higgsfield.

Natural-sounding dialogue with consistent voices for each character, and accents matched to the target market.

Professional editing, color grading, sound design, and music that support the story.

Burned-in subtitles in a clean style similar to the reference.

Final delivery in 9:16 at 1080x1920, with a 4:5 version if possible.



Ideal candidate



You have a portfolio of narrative or cinematic video work, and ideally you have made drama-style or story-led ads for e-commerce or direct-response brands. You can keep characters and settings consistent across a long video, and you understand pacing well enough to hold attention for several minutes. Experience with AI filmmaking tools is a strong plus, but strong traditional production experience is equally welcome.



To apply, please send



Two or three samples of your best narrative or cinematic video work, especially anything long-form or ad-related.

A short explanation of how you would produce this video, including whether you would film it, generate it with AI, or combine both.

A fixed price and turnaround time for this one video.

Whether you can also help develop the script, or whether you prefer to work from a finished one.



Payment is a flat fee for this single project, and the gig ends once the final video is delivered and approved. Applications without relevant samples will not be considered.

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

As the business continues to develop, they are looking for an experienced Financial Controller to take full ownership of the company's finance and accounting function. This is an opportunity to work directly with company directors, oversee financial operations, improve reporting processes, and contribute to important commercial decisions.



Job Type: Full-Time (Remote – UK Business Hours)



Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, fully qualified Financial Controller to independently manage the complete finance and accounting function of a UK limited company. This is a hands-on position requiring strong technical accounting knowledge and practical experience with UK financial reporting, VAT, PAYE payroll, HMRC compliance, cash flow management, credit control, and reconciliations. You will work directly with the company directors, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting while maintaining full compliance with UK accounting and tax requirements. The ideal candidate is someone who can take ownership from day one, requires no training, and has previous experience managing the accounts of UK-based businesses. Experience in construction, manufacturing, stone fabrication, or similar industries would be a strong advantage.



Key Responsibilities:

- Take full ownership of the company's day-to-day finance and accounting operations.

- Prepare and deliver accurate monthly management accounts, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports, by the 10th working day of each month.

- Maintain and update rolling 13-week cash flow forecasts.

- Prepare and submit UK VAT returns through Making Tax Digital (MTD), ensuring all deadlines are met.

- Manage UK PAYE payroll, including RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions, and statutory payments.

- Handle HMRC correspondence, tax compliance, and relevant reporting requirements.

- Manage credit control, proactively chasing overdue invoices and maintaining accurate aged-debtor reports.

- Perform regular bank, card, ledger, VAT, payroll, and control account reconciliations.

- Oversee purchase ledger activities, including supplier invoice processing and timely payments.

- Monitor job and project profitability, including material costs, stock usage, and wastage.

- Produce monthly job-costing and site profitability reports.

- Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting systems, and accounting automation.

- Work directly with company directors, providing financial insights and supporting business decisions.



Requirements:

- Fully qualified accountant with ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification.

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience independently managing the full accounts function of a UK limited company.

- Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, P&L statements, balance sheets, and year-end figures without supervision.

- Strong practical knowledge of UK VAT and Making Tax Digital, including end-to-end VAT return preparation and submission.

- Experience managing UK PAYE payroll, RTI submissions, auto-enrolment pensions, and statutory payments.

- Practical experience with UK tax compliance and HMRC requirements.

- Strong credit control experience, including directly chasing customers for overdue payments by phone and
.

- Excellent knowledge of bank, card, ledger, and control account reconciliations.

- Proficiency in cloud accounting software such as Xero, Sage, or QuickBooks. Xero experience is particularly valuable.

- Strong Excel skills and the ability to produce accurate financial reports.

- Previous experience working with UK clients, directors, suppliers, or accounting firms.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, solve problems, and meet deadlines without supervision.

- Own reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a quiet, secure remote workspace.

- Availability to work UK business hours.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Previous experience in construction, manufacturing, stone fabrication, kitchen and bathroom, or building materials industries.

- Knowledge of CIS (Construction Industry Scheme) and the construction VAT domestic reverse charge.

- Experience with job costing, project profitability, stock management, and material wastage tracking.

- Experience with CRM or job-management systems integrated with accounting software.

- Experience implementing new accounting software, improving financial processes, or automating reporting.

- Experience with vehicle finance, fleet costs, banking relationships, and business lending.

- Registered as an HMRC agent or previous experience working with HMRC agent access.

- Previous experience supporting UK businesses from an offshore location.



Benefits:

Self-motivated, organized, persistent, goal-oriented and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

You edit only — no filming, no scriptwriting, no AI generation, no publishing. You may apply for Track A, Track B, or both — say which in your application.



Track A — Work Smart Agent Academy Editor: Education for real estate agents and brokers. 8-12 minute screen-share lessons, 16:9, plus 30-45 second agent shorts. Real GoHighLevel demos with the presenter in a cropped navy inset, hard cuts, chapter markers, and captions. Blur last names,
s, and phone numbers without hiding software buttons and menus. Initial target: 1 long-form tutorial + 2 shorts weekly.



Track B — Win With Falecia Editor: Georgia new-construction tours for homebuyers. 45-60 second vertical tours (1080x1920), 8-12 minute long-form tours, plus 30-45 second buyer shorts. Original walkthrough footage only. Use only verified facts I give you — never invent a price, feature, incentive, or payment. Initial target: 1 long-form tour + 2-3 shorts weekly, depending on available footage.



Weekly volumes are initial targets, not guaranteed assignments. Work is flexible, remote, and assignment-based. There are no guaranteed minimum hours — please confirm availability before accepting each assignment. Both tracks follow the same rules: editing only, follow the template exactly, protect privacy, and return the project file. The agent audience and buyer audience are never mixed in the same short.



What you will do: Track A — 8-12 min lessons, 16:9, hard cuts, chapter markers, agent shorts, presenter inset stays visible, captions big bold white on talking-head (current word gold), small in black bar below screen recordings (current word teal), no added text over any screen recording, blur last names/emails/phones everywhere, spell the name exactly: Falecia. Track B — 45-60 sec vertical tours + 8-12 min long-form tours + buyer shorts, smooth cuts, clean zooms, readable gold/white captions, watermark moves about every 15 seconds never covering face/caption/price/feature, CTA is Comment TOUR — booking link 
/book, no direct builder link, no invented pricing or incentives, deliver shorts without music baked in.



Both editors must have: CapCut (preferred) or Premiere Pro; proven experience in the formats relevant to your selected track only; accurate captions and spelling — check names word by word; clean privacy blurring that keeps controls visible; reliable internet for large files, clear written English, discipline to follow a template exactly — and ask before you guess.



You will NOT be asked to: film anything, write scripts, generate AI video or voice, publish or upload, contact clients, or promise results. If a detail is not in the brief, you ask — you do not invent it.



Project files — required on every delivery: Deliver the native editable CapCut or Premiere Pro project, all linked source media and assets, and the final exported MP4. Projects must open successfully on my system without missing files. CapCut is preferred whenever possible; Premiere Pro is accepted. Please disclose your exact software version and confirm project compatibility before accepting work.



Pay: Please provide your hourly rate and proposed fixed price per completed video for your selected track. Paid test compensation will be agreed upon before work begins. Payment schedule: Fixed price per approved video, paid through the agreed platform. Approval window is two business days after complete delivery; that window is for reviewing the completed delivery and either approving it or requesting corrections, not withholding payment indefinitely. Payment is made promptly under the platform's applicable terms.



Arrangement: Flexible, remote, assignment-based independent contractor work. No guaranteed minimum hours. Editors must confirm availability before accepting assignments. Turnaround: First cut due within 48-72 hours after receipt of all required footage, assets, and instructions. One consolidated revision round is included per video. Additional scope changes must be approved before work begins. Who edits: Independent editors preferred. If applying through a team or agency, identify the person performing the editing. No subcontracting or editor substitutions without written approval. Confidentiality: All supplied footage, client information, scripts, and project materials are confidential. Do not share, reuse, publish, or place them in a portfolio without written permission. Do not upload materials to third-party AI services without approval.



Please do not apply if: your portfolio is only weddings, cinematic reels, or AI-generated clips, or you cannot return the project file as described above. Generic copy-paste proposals will be deleted.



How to apply — read carefully: Start your application with the word NAVY so I know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be interviewed. First line after NAVY: tell me your track — TRACK A (Work Smart Agent Academy), TRACK B (Win With Falecia), or BOTH. Then answer all six questions:

1. Link 2 videos you personally edited in your track's format — screen-share tutorials for Track A, vertical / long-form tours for Track B (both formats if you apply for BOTH). For each: what did you cut, and what software and project file did you deliver?

2. How would you blur names, phone numbers, and
s in a GoHighLevel screen recording without hiding the buttons and menus? Show an example if you have one. Track B applicants: How would you ensure property details and captions match the supplied footage and verified facts?

3. Please provide your hourly rate and proposed fixed price per completed video for your selected track. Paid test compensation will be agreed upon before work begins. If you apply for BOTH, estimate both.

4. Who exactly will edit — you, by name, or someone else on a team?

5. Walk me through your caption quality check: how do you catch a misspelled name before delivery?

6. What is your first-cut turnaround, how many revision rounds do you include, and what are your working hours and time zone?

Paid test: Shortlisted applicants get a 60-90-second paid sample using supplied footage and a real editing template, with a fixed test fee agreed before work begins. No unpaid test work. Track A test covers privacy blurring and captions; Track B test covers pacing, captions, and watermark placement. Native project files are required for both — the project-file handoff is nonnegotiable. The paid test's deadline will be agreed upon before work begins. Paid tests will be evaluated separately for each track. Successful candidates may be offered ongoing assignments based on quality, reliability, communication, and project-file delivery.

# Functional Consultant / Business Analyst (ERP / Odoo)



We're helping a small but growing Canadian consulting company find a **Functional Consultant / Business Analyst** to join their remote team.



The company helps small to mid-sized businesses improve their operations by fixing inefficient processes, organizing their systems, and implementing ERP solutions, primarily Odoo.



We're looking for someone who understands both **business processes and how systems work**. Someone who can speak with stakeholders, understand their problems, figure out what needs to change, and work with technical teams to make it happen.



This isn't a coding role. It's more about understanding the business, translating requirements into practical solutions, and making sure everything works as intended.



### What you'll be doing



- Understand business processes and gather requirements from stakeholders.

- Map workflows, identify problems, and recommend improvements.

- Translate business needs into clear requirements for developers.

- Help implement and improve ERP systems, primarily Odoo.

- Test solutions, conduct demos, and help users understand new processes.

- Manage your assigned work, follow up on open items, and see things through to completion.



### Who we're looking for



- At least 2 years of experience as a Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, or similar role.

- Experience with ERP systems. Odoo is preferred, but SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics, or similar systems are welcome.

- Good understanding of business operations such as inventory, purchasing, sales, or finance.

- Comfortable with process mapping, documentation, and understanding how systems connect.

- Good communication skills, including speaking directly with clients when needed.

- Someone organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.



**One thing worth highlighting:** The team is small, so they're looking for someone who takes ownership rather than someone who needs constant instructions. You should be comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, and following through until problems are resolved.



### Work setup



- Fully remote, Philippines-based preferred

- Flexible working hours

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Long-term opportunity with a growing company

- Work directly with an experienced founder and a small team



### Interested?



Please send us your updated resume along with your answers to the screening questions:



1) Have you worked for an ERP consulting firm, implementation partner, or a company that provides consulting services to multiple clients? Or has your experience been mainly in-house, supporting one company's systems? Please briefly describe the companies you've worked for and the type of clients or businesses you supported.



2) Which best describes your experience: Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, Technical Consultant/Developer, or a mix of these? What were you personally responsible for? For example, gathering requirements, process mapping, solution design, configuration, development, testing, training, or go-live support. etc.



3) Client Markets & Exposure: Have you supported clients or businesses in the US, Canada, Australia, Europe, or other international markets? Or has your experience been mainly with Philippine companies?



If mainly local, were you part of an internal ERP/IT team in a larger organization or working with external clients?



4) ERP Projects & Implementations

What ERP systems have you worked with, and what types of projects have you handled (new implementations, migrations, integrations, process improvements, etc.)?



Please mention the industries you've supported, the modules or business functions involved, and your specific contribution to these projects.



*Additional details about the company and opportunity will be shared with candidates who progress through our initial screening.*

We use **Vidrush** to create documentary/ lisitcle-style videos, typically 10–15 minutes long.



What you'll do

- Edit 3–4 YouTube videos per week using Vidrush.

- Select relevant, high-quality visuals that match the script and voice-over.

- Ensure historical accuracy in the footage and images used.

- Maintain engaging pacing and a consistent documentary editing style.

- Pay close attention to details, transitions, and overall video quality.



What we're looking for

- Experience with Vidrush is preferred, but not required.

- **A genuine interest in World War II history is very important.**

- Good understanding of WWII vehicles, aircraft, military equipment, and historical events is a big plus.

- Strong attention to detail. Our audience quickly notices historical inaccuracies.

- Reliable, independent, and able to meet deadlines.

- Good English communication skills.



What we provide

- Completed scripts and voice-overs.

- Access to Vidrush.

- Clear instructions and reference videos.

- Consistent work: 3–4 videos per week.

- Opportunity for long-term collaboration.



How to apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with video editing or Vidrush.

3. Your interest in or knowledge of World War II history.

4. Examples of previous work, if available.

5. Your expected rate per completed video.



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys WWII history and takes pride in creating accurate, engaging videos.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Part-Time Video Editor & Content Assistant for Islamic Content Brand
description:

I run a Muslim mentorship brand with an active social media presence across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and I’m building an online course and webinar. Course and webinar editing (upcoming):



- Edit recorded webinar from raw footage — sync slides with voiceover, add transitions, clean up audio

- Edit course lesson recordings — slides with a speaker circle overlay, clean cuts between speech and slide sections

- Assemble slide decks from a brand template and written instructions I provide

- Export finished lessons ready for upload to a course platform



General content support:



- Scheduling and uploading posts across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube when needed

- Creating cover frames and thumbnails from brand templates

- File organisation and management

- Backup of all content to a Google Drive account



What I’ll provide:



Raw footage and the approved script for each piece of content

A brand guide (colours, fonts, caption style, slide template)

Clear written instructions for every task



Requirements:



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar video editing tools

Able to work with slide-based video (syncing slides to speech, picture-in-picture layouts)

Reliable internet and ability to receive large video files

Good English communication

Available for ongoing work, approximately 5–10 hours per week initially, with room to grow



Please include a link to previous short-form video editing work and any course/webinar editing samples if you have them.

 Applications without a completed form will not be reviewed.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Business Development & Staffing Partnership Specialist
description:
Business Development & Staffing Partnerships Specialist

Workforce Management Inc. | Schaumburg, Illinois



Salary: $5.00 to 10.00



Industry: Staffing & Recruiting | Healthcare | Manufacturing | Logistics | Professional Services



About Workforce Management Inc.



Workforce Management Inc. is an established, certified woman-owned staffing firm with more than 30 years of industry experience and over 12 years of business operations.



We provide temporary staffing, temp-to-hire, direct placement, and specialized recruiting solutions across healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, skilled trades, administrative, and professional industries.



As we continue expanding our client relationships and staffing partnerships nationwide, we are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy, detail-oriented individual to support our business development efforts.



Position Overview



We are looking for a motivated Business Development & Staffing Partnerships Specialist who enjoys researching opportunities, working with technology, communicating with prospective clients, and turning information into actionable business opportunities.



This position combines internet research, artificial intelligence (AI), data management, business development, outbound prospecting, and administrative coordination.



The ideal candidate is an exceptionally detail-oriented individual who learns quickly, works independently, and is comfortable using ChatGPT, Microsoft Excel, online databases, and various business platforms to identify prospective clients and staffing partnerships.



You will work closely with company leadership to research potential clients, identify decision-makers, pursue vendor registrations, develop prospect lists, and initiate business relationships through phone calls,
s, text messages, and online applications.



This is a hands-on position requiring someone who can research an opportunity, organize the information, make contact, complete the necessary applications, and follow through until the next step is secured.



Key Responsibilities



Internet Research & Lead Generation

• Conduct extensive online research to identify companies utilizing temporary staffing, contract labor, direct-hire recruiting, and workforce solutions.

• Identify prospective clients across healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, distribution, and professional industries.

• Research hospitals, healthcare systems, manufacturing facilities, distribution centers, and other potential staffing clients.

• Identify MSP (Managed Service Provider), VMS (Vendor Management System), and supplier partnership opportunities.

• Locate vendor registration portals, supplier applications, procurement opportunities, and RFPs.

• Research company websites, LinkedIn, job postings, business directories, and procurement databases.

• Identify hiring managers, procurement contacts, HR directors, vendor managers, and other decision-makers.

• Monitor new business opportunities, supplier openings, and partnership announcements.



ChatGPT, AI & Spreadsheet Management

• Utilize ChatGPT and other approved AI tools to accelerate business research, organize information, and improve productivity.

• Create detailed Microsoft Excel spreadsheets and prospect databases using ChatGPT-assisted workflows.

• Organize leads by company, location, industry, contact information, staffing needs, and potential revenue opportunity.

• Develop spreadsheets tracking MSP/VMS programs, vendor registrations, supplier approval status, and follow-up activities.

• Use AI to assist with drafting professional
s, prospecting messages, research summaries, and sales materials.

• Verify AI-generated information for accuracy before entering it into company systems or using it for outreach.

• Maintain accurate, organized, and regularly updated business development records.



Sales Outreach & Business Development

• Make outbound phone calls to prospective clients and staffing partners.

• Send professional introductory
s and appropriate business text messages.

• Follow up with prospective clients to identify staffing needs and partnership opportunities.

• Schedule introductory meetings and sales calls for company leadership.

• Identify opportunities for temporary staffing, contract staffing, direct placement, and healthcare staffing services.

• Develop customized outreach messages based on the prospect's industry and workforce needs.

• Maintain consistent follow-up communication and build relationships with prospective clients.

• Track conversations, responses, appointments, and business development progress.



Staffing Partnerships & Vendor Registrations

• Research and apply for staffing supplier opportunities with MSPs, VMS providers, hospitals, healthcare systems, and corporate clients.

• Complete online vendor registration forms and supplier applications.

• Coordinate required documentation, including company credentials, insurance certificates, certifications, and business information.

• Track registration submissions, approval status, outstanding requirements, and next steps.

• Follow up with supplier relations teams, procurement departments, and vendor management representatives.

• Identify government contracting and supplier diversity opportunities.

• Assist with RFP responses, vendor questionnaires, and capability statements.

• Maintain an organized database of all submitted applications and potential partnerships.



CRM, Reporting & Administrative Coordination

• Maintain accurate prospect and activity records in Avionté or other company-approved systems.

• Develop and update lead generation reports, spreadsheets, and sales pipelines.

• Track daily calls,
s, text messages, applications, responses, and meetings scheduled.

• Provide management with concise progress reports identifying opportunities, challenges, and next steps.

• Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ensure no promising lead or vendor application is overlooked.

• Support leadership with research, presentations, and special business development projects.



Required Qualifications

• Strong computer literacy and proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and internet-based applications.

• Ability to use ChatGPT or learn AI-assisted research and spreadsheet workflows quickly.

• Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organization.

• Strong internet research skills and the ability to locate information efficiently.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable making outbound phone calls and communicating with business professionals.

• Ability to write professional
s and follow-up messages.

• Quick learner who can navigate unfamiliar websites, portals, and software platforms.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

• Strong follow-through and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable managing spreadsheets, databases, and multiple active projects.

• Professional, dependable, resourceful, and results-oriented.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in staffing, recruiting, business development, sales support, lead generation, or vendor management.

• Familiarity with MSP/VMS staffing programs and supplier registration processes.

• Experience researching healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, or professional staffing opportunities.

• Experience with Avionté, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM/ATS platforms.

• Familiarity with LinkedIn prospecting and business contact research.

• Experience completing online vendor applications, supplier registrations, or RFP documentation.

• Strong Excel skills, including filtering, sorting, formulas, and data organization.

• Experience using ChatGPT to create spreadsheets, draft communications, and conduct business research.



Prior staffing industry experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train a highly motivated individual who demonstrates exceptional computer skills, attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to learn quickly.



What Success Looks Like
